These bearing is a non-geared four-point contact ball slewing ring bearing manufactured by INA. This light-series industrial component is engineered to handle complex radial, axial, and tilting moment loads simultaneously. It is primarily utilized in heavy machinery repair shops, agriculture, and mining applications like excavators or rotary tables.  A single row of balls makes contact at four distinct points on the raceways, allowing a single bearing to handle axial, radial, and tilting moment loads simultaneously. Material : Made from high-grade carbon-chromium bearing steel featuring induction-hardened raceways and internal polyamide ball spacers. Features are : Low Startup Resistance, Optimized Raceway Oscillation, Broad Temperature Threshold, Sealing & Maintenance Features. Applicaations : Construction & Material Handling, Renewable Energy Systems, Maritime & Off-Shore Equipment, Mining & Bulk Material Processing, Aerospace & Defense Systems, Agricultural Machinery, Medical Equipment, Food & Beverage Processing.

These bearing is a high-performance four-point contact ball slewing ring bearing manufactured by INA. This specific part number represents a non-geared, light-series rotating joint engineered to safely transmit massive axial, radial, and tilting moment forces simultaneously within space-constrained mechanisms. The internal raceways are precision-ground so that each steel ball makes contact at four distinct points. This unique geometry allows a single-row bearing to simultaneously absorb radial, axial, and tilting moment loads. These bearing is a high-rigidity, toothless crossed roller slewing ring bearing. Unlike conventional designs that use separate radial and thrust bearings, it features a single-row 90° crossed cylindrical roller geometry separated by spacers. This enables it to firmly support severe axial, radial, and tilting moment forces at the same time. It comes preloaded to ensure micrometer-level precision and zero operational backlash. Material : Forged 42CrMo alloy steel rings, GCr15 chrome steel rollers, Nylon spacers, and NBR rubber seals. Features are : Low Profile/Compact Footprint, High Rotational Accuracy & Rigidity,  Low, Uniform Rotational Torque, Integrated Multi-Axis Performance, Thermal and Environmental Resilience, High-Tier Precision and Tolerance Ratings. Applications : Robotics and Automation, Medical and Laboratory Equipment, Aerospace, Defense, and Optical Systems, Semiconductor Wafer Handling Equipment, Renewable Energy Systems, Marine, Offshore, and Subsea Technology, Heavy Material Processing and Handling.

desc: CF - CAM FOLLOWERS With HEX HOLES (LUBRI-DISC SEALS)
tech: McGill CAMROL bearings are full complement needle bearings feature black oxide treated bearing steel, available in two basic mounting styles for use in mechanical automation or linear motion applications. Full-type roller bearing CF bearing the ultimate in radial capacity, improving its load-carrying qualities to complement its resistance to shock. A soft stud stem adds toughness and permits reworking for slight dimensional changes. Holes through either side or ends of the stud provide for convenient relubrication. Cam followers with LUBRI-DISC seals. CF - Cam Follower, N = Narrow Roller Width, “SB” means: S = Sealed, B = Hex Hole (“B” indicates the hex hole in the head, for installation/removal). Used where a roller (follower) needs to roll along a cam or track while being mounted by a stud; handles radial loads, shock, etc. The sealed version (with LUBRI-DISC®) helps with protection and lubrication retention.

desc: CFH-SB SERIES HEAVY STUD CAM FOLLOWERS WITH HEX HOLE & LUBRI-DISC SEALS
tech: McGill CAMROL bearings are full complement needle bearings feature black oxide treated bearing steel, available in two basic mounting styles for use in mechanical automation or linear motion applications. CFH - Heavy Stud Cam Follower, S - Sealed Version, B - Hex Socket. Hexagonal hole is provided in the stud face on selected sizes for use with applications involving bearings mounted in blind holes or with self-locking nuts requiring greater than average thread torque. Protection & Longevity: The sealed design (LUBRI-DISC) helps retain lubricant and prevents ingress of contaminants (dust, moisture, particles), improving service life especially in harsh environments. Hex head (broached) allows convenient tool access. Pre-lubrication reduces initial maintenance needs.

desc: CYR-S SERIES YOKE CAM FOLLOWERS WITH LUBRI-DISC SEALS
tech: CYR stands for yoke (shaft-mounted) cam followers / rollers. The “S” suffix indicates sealed versions - i.e. these have built-in LUBRI-DISC seals on both sides to retain lubricant and help exclude contamination. These are yoke-type rollers, meaning they mount on a shaft or journal (not via a stud). Roller elements and raceways: chrome bearing steel. External surfaces: black oxide or similar corrosion-resistant finish. Seals help maintain lubricant life and protect internal roller/race elements from external contaminants. Because grease retention is better and contamination ingress reduced, life under harsher conditions is improved. Sealed versions require less frequent relubrication compared to open counterparts. Heavy cross-sectioned outer race helps resist shock loads common in cam / track follower applications.

THREAD=M5. The POS bearing is a rod end. Rod ends consist of a housing with integral shank and a spherical plain bearing. This plain bearing is composed of an inner and outer ring without rolling elements. Rod ends are often mounted on the end of hydraulic or pneumatic cylinders. They are also used to connect two shafts. Rod ends can accommodate misalignment, and they support radial forces in a tensile or compressive direction. These bearing has a spherical plain bearing with a steel-on-bronze sliding contact. The steel inner ring contacts the bronze surface of the outer ring. The steel-on-bronze sliding contact makes this bearing highly wear-resistant, providing low friction. However, the load capacity is slightly lower compared to spherical plain bearings with steel-on-steel sliding contacts. This bearing needs regular maintenance. Proper lubrication is required to reduce friction and prevent fouling and corrosion.

The inner ring has a convex outer surface. The outer ring has a concave inner surface. This construction gives spherical plain bearings their high load carrying capacity and capacity to accommodate misalignment. These bearing has a steel-on-steel sliding contact. Both the outer and inner rings of this bearing are made of steel. Bearings with steel-on-steel sliding contacts are wear-resistant and have a high load carrying capacity. This bearing type requires regular maintenance. Proper lubrication is required to reduce friction and prevent fouling and corrosion. E=Split Outer Ring Without Lubrication Holes.

The SKE-1 bearing is a specialized metric hydraulic rod end bearing designed specifically for welding onto hydraulic cylinder rods or machinery. It is a characterized by its cylindrical shank with a locating pin, which facilitates precise alignment during the welding process. Material : The housing made from structural carbon steel suitable for welding. The inner ring made from a high-precision chrome steel, often hardened and chromium-plated to reduce friction and wear during oscillation. It generally uses a steel-on-steel sliding contact surface, making it suitable for high-load, low-speed oscillating movements. Features are : Static and Dynamic Capacities, No Relubrication Facility, Operating Temperature, Self-Aligning Capability, High Angular Misalignment, Temperature Stability. Applications : Construction Equipment, Agricultural Machinery, Automation Machinery, Conveyor Systems, Mining Machinery, Tractors and Harvesters, Packaging Systems, Medical and Fitness Equipment, Aerospace Industry. E1=steel-on-steel sliding contact surface wtih no relubrication facility.

The GE...E SKF bearing is a spherical plain bearing. Spherical plain bearings are two-piece plain bearings. They have no rolling elements, but consist of an inner and outer ring. The inner ring has a convex outer surface. The outer ring has a concave inner surface. This construction gives spherical plain bearings their high load carrying capacity and capacity to accommodate misalignment. These beariing has a steel-on-steel sliding contact. Both the outer and inner rings of this bearing are made of steel. Bearings with steel-on-steel sliding contacts are wear-resistant and have a high load carrying capacity. This bearing type requires regular maintenance. Proper lubrication is required to reduce friction and prevent fouling and corrosion. E=Split Outer Ring Without Lubrication Holes.

This bearing type requires regular maintenance. Proper lubrication is required to reduce friction and prevent fouling and corrosion. The inner ring has a convex outer surface. The outer ring has a concave inner surface. This construction gives spherical plain bearings their high load carrying capacity and capacity to accommodate misalignment. These bearing has a steel-on-steel sliding contact. Both the outer and inner rings of this bearing are made of steel. Bearings with steel-on-steel sliding contacts are wear-resistant and have a high load carrying capacity. This bearing type requires regular maintenance. Proper lubrication is required to reduce friction and prevent fouling and corrosion. The SF..ES is a hydraulic weld-on rod end bearing designed specifically for heavy-duty applications such as hydraulic and pneumatic cylinders. It consists of a GE25ES series radial spherical plain bearing fixed within a weldable steel housing featuring a rectangular welding face. Material : The inner and outer rings are typically made of high-carbon rolling bearing steel. The housing Made from weldable steel with a rectangular welding shank, enabling it to be directly welded to piston rods or cylinder bases with a steel/steel sliding combination. Features are : Replaceable Bearing Unit, High Load Capacity, Angular Misalignment Tolerance, Relubrication System, Extreme Temperature Tolerance, Reduced Friction, Heavy Static Stability. Applications : Construction Equipment, Agricultural Machinery, Mining and Earth-Moving, Material Handling, Textile Machinery, Packaging Machinery, Printing Machinery, Marine & Offshore. ES=Steel-on-Steel.

desc: CYR-S SERIES YOKE CAM FOLLOWERS WITH LUBRI-DISC SEALS
tech: CYR stands for yoke (shaft-mounted) cam followers / rollers. The “S” suffix indicates sealed versions - i.e. these have built-in LUBRI-DISC seals on both sides to retain lubricant and help exclude contamination. These are yoke-type rollers, meaning they mount on a shaft or journal (not via a stud). Roller elements and raceways: chrome bearing steel. External surfaces: black oxide or similar corrosion-resistant finish. Seals help maintain lubricant life and protect internal roller/race elements from external contaminants. Because grease retention is better and contamination ingress reduced, life under harsher conditions is improved. Sealed versions require less frequent relubrication compared to open counterparts. Heavy cross-sectioned outer race helps resist shock loads common in cam / track follower applications.

desc: INNER RING FOR NEEDLE ROLLER BEARING
tech: The Nadella BI series is a cylindrical inner ring, designed for use with needle roller bearings. It provides a precision-ground raceway when the shaft cannot be hardened and ground. Used to provide a hard, precision running surface for needle roller bearings when the shaft\'s surface is not suitable for a direct raceway. Designed to be paired with needle roller and cage assemblies or drawn cup needle roller bearings. Material : Constructed from bearing steel (comparable to SAE 52100) and then hardened and precision ground for durability and accuracy. Features are : Accommodates axial displacement, Compatibility, Cost-Effective Solution, Simplified assembly. Applications : Conveyor systems, Industrial pumps and compressors, Machine tools, Packaging and printing machines, Gearboxes and Transmissions, Planetary gears, Off-road and agricultural machinery, Construction equipment, Material handling, Food and packaging industry, Wood, paper, and pulp industry, Textile machinery. R6 : Convex Inner Ring Raceway.

desc: INNER RING FOR NEEDLE ROLLER BEARING
tech: The Nadella BIC bearing is a specific needle roller bearing inner ring. It is not a complete bearing on its own but is designed to be used with a needle roller and cage assembly, serving as the inner raceway for the needle rollers when the shaft itself cannot be used for that purpose. The bearing is manufactured from high-quality chrome steel by Nadella. The BIC series is typically mounted with a tight interference fit in the housing bore. This enables a simple and economical design, as shoulders or snap rings are not required for axial location. Material : High-quality chrome steel (SAE 52100 equivalent). Features are : High Load Capacity, Compact Design, Durability and Precision, Axial Displacement, Ease of Assembly. Applications : Automotive transmissions and gearboxes, Pumps and compressors, Industrial presses and conveyors, Heavy-duty industrial setups, Packaging Machinery, Medical Equipment.

desc: GUIDE RAIL FOR TRACK ROLLER BEARING
tech: The Nadella GU series is a steel guide rail used for linear guidance systems, designed for high-load and demanding industrial conditions. The GU series rail provides a durable, hardened track surface for rollers to run along. The system as a whole is engineered for applications requiring robustness, high load capacity (both radial and axial), and reliable operation even in challenging environments. Material : Made from cold-drawn solid bearing steel, ensuring high strength and a long service life. Features are : High Load Capacity, High Dynamic Performance, Accommodates Misalignment, Integrated Axial and Radial Support, Ease of Installation, Reduced Friction and Noise, Low Maintenance. Applications : Heavy Industry & Steel Manufacturing, Automation and Robotics, Machine Tools & Woodworking, Material Handling, Medical and Printing Machinery, Packaging machinery. MT: The raceways are sandblasted.

desc: GUIDE WHEEL WITH TAPERED ROLLER BEARINGS
tech: The Nadella FK...C is a heavy-duty guide roller with tapered roller bearings, designed for the GP series rails of the Nadella Heavy-Line system. This system is specifically built for high-load applications in demanding, aggressive, or contaminated industrial environments. The FK...C is a self-retained bearing unit with a thick-walled outer ring. This construction allows it to absorb high radial forces as well as axial forces in both directions. Its robust tapered roller bearings are what give it this high load-bearing capacity and rigidity. Materials : It features rolling elements made from standard bearing steel. Features are : High load capacity, Environmental resistance, Reduced friction, Corrosion resistance, High speed capability, Lubricated for life, Low Maintenance, Smooth Operation. Applications : Material Handling Systems, Heavy Industry, Machine Tools, Automation and Robotics, Construction and Mining, Power Generation, Chemical Industry.

The Nadella GC series is a cam follower with needle rollers. These rolling elements combine high load capacity with a compact design. Cam followers are designed for use with various types of tracks. Thanks to a thick-walled outer ring, they can withstand high radial loads. Instead of an inner ring, they feature a solid, threaded stud, enabling easy mounting. Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support. This bearing has a full complement design. The absence of a cage allows for a greater number of rolling elements, making this cam follower radially highly loadable. Full complement cam followers are also more shock-resistant than cam followers with a cage. However, the maximum rotational speed is lower than that of caged variants. Common applications of cam followers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam mechanisms.

The FR...EU Nadella is a ball-bearing stud type track roller or cam follower, of which the rolling elements combine low friction with high precision. Cam followers are designed for use with various types of tracks. Thanks to a thick-walled outer ring, they can withstand high radial loads. Instead of an inner ring, they feature a solid, threaded stud, enabling easy mounting. Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support. These bearing is equipped with a cage that prevents the rolling elements from coming into contact with each other. This design allows for a controlled movement of the rolling elements. There is lower friction compared to full complement cam followers, allowing for higher rotational speeds and less heat generation. Common applications of support rollers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam mechanisms. EU: Internal double-row ball bearing for high dynamic performance.\n

desc: GUIDE ROLLERS WITH TAPERED ROLLER BEARINGS
tech: The Nadella RKXR...C is an eccentric guide roller that is part of the V-Line linear guide system, designed for high speeds and various industrial machinery applications. It is engineered for use in demanding environments, offering high load capacity and resistance to contamination. It is a self-retained construction unit with a very thick-walled outer ring, enabling it to absorb high radial forces and axial loads in both directions. The \"R\" in the part number indicates it is the eccentric version, which allows for adjustment during installation to achieve a clearance-free fit with the guide rail. The eccentric design facilitates greater alignment tolerances compared to some other systems, potentially reducing installation time and cost. It is supplied complete with a self-locking washer and hexagonal nut for fitting. C=Concentric Stud.

The roller features an internal tapered roller bearing for high load capacity and is designed to accommodate misalignment in the linear system.Material: The standard version is made from bearing steel. The Nadella FKX...C bearing is used in various industrial applications that require precise and reliable linear motion, especially those with high speeds, high acceleration, and potentially difficult ambient or dirty conditions.

desc: FLOATING GUIDE ROLLERS WITH BALL BEARING
tech: The FRL...EU is a stud-type track roller that features a robust, thick-walled outer ring capable of withstanding high radial forces. It uses a single row of ball bearings held in a cage, which allows for controlled movement, lower friction compared to full complement designs, and higher rotational speeds. Instead of a separate inner ring, it has a solid, threaded stud for straightforward mounting onto a flat guide track (not a housing bore). Material: Made from standard bearing steel (Chrome Steel GCr15). The floating design and slightly convex race sides of the outer ring help accommodate minor guide flexing or assembly alignment errors, reducing the need for high-precision machining during installation. Applications : Conveyor systems, Robotics and handling systems, Packaging and machine tools, Linear guidance systems, Woodworking and assembly machines. L=Floating bearing constructions.

desc: FLOATING GUIDE ROLLERS WITH BALL BEARING
tech: The FRLR...EU is a self-retained V-Line guide roller bearing unit featuring a solid, threaded stud instead of a traditional inner ring, which simplifies mounting. The \'LR\' in the designation indicates a loose or \"floating\" fit, as opposed to a fixed (concentric) one, which helps accommodate alignment errors during assembly. The outer ring has a convex running surface to reduce rolling friction and allow for slight guide flexing or minor misalignment without compromising function. It uses caged balls as rolling elements, allowing for higher rotational speeds and less heat generation compared to full-complement designs. Material : Standard bearing steel (Chrome steel GCr15). Applications : Linear guidance systems, Conveyor systems, Cam mechanisms, Packaging and printing machinery, General automation and material handling equipment. E : Optimized Internal Design, U : Sealed Version.

desc: FLOATING GUIDE ROLLERS WITH TAPERED ROLLER BEARINGS
tech: The RKYL Nadella bearing is a floating guide roller with a tapered roller bearing and a solid, threaded stud designed specifically for use in Nadella\'s V-Line linear guidance systems. The RKYL bearing is a self-retained construction unit with a thick-walled outer ring capable of withstanding high radial loads. The \"L\" in the part number indicates it is a floating guide roller, which allows it to absorb axial loads resulting from alignment errors or misalignment between the guide roller and the rail. The bearing utilizes internal rolling elements made of standard bearing steel and features a cage that ensures controlled movement of the rolling elements, resulting in lower friction and less heat generation compared to full complement designs. Applications : Material Handling and Conveyor Systems, Robotics and Automation, General and Heavy Industry, Woodworking machinery, Packaging and printing machines, Machine tools and assembly machines, Electro-medical machines and measuring instruments.

desc: FLOATING GUIDE ROLLERS WITH TAPERED ROLLER BEARINGS
tech: The RKXL bearing is a floating guide roller with a stud, specifically engineered for the Nadella V-Line linear guide system. Unlike standard concentric rollers that provide fixed positioning, the \"RKXL\" series is designed to accommodate \"floating\" or non-locating bearing arrangements, allowing for axial movement to compensate for misalignments or thermal expansion. It allows for axial displacement, making it ideal for systems where two parallel guide rails might not be perfectly aligned. A self-retained unit with a thick-walled outer ring and a high load capacity. The integrated stud facilitates easy mounting. Features are : Maintenance-Free Operation, Temperature Tolerance, High Load Capacity. Applications : Robotics and Automation, Packaging Machinery, Machine Tools, Material Handling, Wood and Metal Working, Textile Machinery, Printing Presses.

desc: FLOATING GUIDE ROLLERS WITH TAPERED ROLLER BEARINGS
tech: The RKYLR bearing is a high-performance floating guide roller equipped with tapered roller bearings, designed specifically for the Nadella V-Line linear guide systems. It is engineered to handle heavy loads while allowing for axial displacement to compensate for mounting misalignments. RKYR series, the \"L\" suffix indicates a floating roller designed to absorb axial movement and compensate for parallelism errors between guide rails. These internal rolling elements allow the bearing to manage high radial forces and axial thrusts simultaneously. Material : Made from high-grade bearing steel with NBR rubber (RS type) seals. Features are : High Load Capacity, Maintenance-Free Operation, Corrosion Resistance, Life-Long Lubrication, Shock Resistance, Speed and Acceleration. Applications : Conveyor systems, Linear guidance systems and modules, Cam mechanisms, Packaging Machinery, Robotics & Automation, Machine Tools & Fabrication, Agricultural machinery and textile production lines. R : Indicates that the outer ring has a crowned (convex) raceway.

The Nadella GC series is a cam follower with needle rollers. These rolling elements combine high load capacity with a compact design. Cam followers are designed for use with various types of tracks. Thanks to a thick-walled outer ring, they can withstand high radial loads. Instead of an inner ring, they feature a solid, threaded stud, enabling easy mounting. Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support. This bearing has a full complement design. The absence of a cage allows for a greater number of rolling elements, making this cam follower radially highly loadable. Full complement cam followers are also more shock-resistant than cam followers with a cage. However, the maximum rotational speed is lower than that of caged variants. Common applications of cam followers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam mechanisms.

The KR bearing is a specific model of stud-type cam follower needle roller bearing. The bearing incorporates a solid, threaded stud  in place of a separate inner ring and bolt assembly, allowing for easy, rigid mounting to support components. The outer ring is thick-walled to reduce distortion and bending stresses, enabling it to withstand heavy radial loads encountered when rolling on tracks or guide rails. The internal rolling elements are a single row of needle rollers, which offer a large contact area with the raceway, thus providing high radial load capacity within a compact form factor. Material : Bearing steel. Features are : High Load Capacity, Accommodates Misalignment, Easy Installation, Low Friction, Life-Long Lubrication. Applications : Automatic Devices, Industrial Robots, Machine Tools, Plastic Machinery, Woodworking Machinery, Printing Presses, Textile Machinery, Conveyor Systems, Medical Equipment, Automotive Components.

The outer ring is thick-walled to reduce distortion and bending stresses, enabling it to withstand heavy radial loads encountered when rolling on tracks or guide rails. The internal rolling elements are a single row of needle rollers, which offer a large contact area with the raceway, thus providing high radial load capacity within a compact form factor. Material : Bearing steel. Features are : High Load Capacity, Accommodates Misalignment, Easy Installation, Low Friction, Life-Long Lubrication. Applications : Automatic Devices, Industrial Robots, Machine Tools, Plastic Machinery, Woodworking Machinery, Printing Presses, Textile Machinery, Conveyor Systems, Medical Equipment, Automotive Components. EE : 	Plastic axial plain washers with formed seal lips on both sides.

The GCU...MM bearing is a cam follower with needle rollers. These rolling elements combine high load capacity with a compact design. Cam followers are designed for use with various types of tracks. Thanks to a thick-walled outer ring, they can withstand high radial loads. Instead of an inner ring, they feature a solid, threaded stud, enabling easy mounting. Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support. These bearing has a full complement design. The absence of a cage allows for a greater number of rolling elements, making this cam follower radially highly loadable. Full complement cam followers are also more shock-resistant than cam followers with a cage. However, the maximum rotational speed is lower than that of caged variants. Common applications of cam followers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam mechanisms. MM=Metal Seals At Each Side Of The Bearing.

The FP bearings is a small, full-complement needle track roller bearing (cam roller without a stud). The Nadella FP series of \"mini rollers,\" which offer the highest load-to-diameter capacity ratio available due to their specialized design. It is a cam roller without a stud (also known as a yoke type track roller or track roller bearing), meaning it must be mounted on a separate shaft or pin. It has a cylindrical bore for this purpose. It features a full complement of needle rollers without a cage, which maximizes the number of rolling elements and directly increases the dynamic and static load capacities and overall rigidity of the bearing. Material : Standard bearing steel (chromium steel). Features are : Precision Engineering, Life-Long Lubrication, Smooth Operation, Low Friction, High Load Capacity, Compact Design, Misalignment Compensation. Applications : Cam Mechanisms, Conveyor and Material Handling Systems, Automated Assembly Lines, Printing and Packaging Machinery, Textile Industry, Automotive and Aerospace, Robotics and Medical Devices, Machine Tools, Agricultural and Construction Machinery, Marine and Offshore Equipment.

The FP bearings is a small, full-complement needle track roller bearing (cam roller without a stud). The Nadella FP series of \"mini rollers,\" which offer the highest load-to-diameter capacity ratio available due to their specialized design. It is a cam roller without a stud (also known as a yoke type track roller or track roller bearing), meaning it must be mounted on a separate shaft or pin. It has a cylindrical bore for this purpose. It features a full complement of needle rollers without a cage, which maximizes the number of rolling elements and directly increases the dynamic and static load capacities and overall rigidity of the bearing. Material : Standard bearing steel (chromium steel). Features are : Precision Engineering, Life-Long Lubrication, Smooth Operation, Low Friction, High Load Capacity, Compact Design, Misalignment Compensation. Applications : Cam Mechanisms, Conveyor and Material Handling Systems, Automated Assembly Lines, Printing and Packaging Machinery, Textile Industry, Automotive and Aerospace, Robotics and Medical Devices, Machine Tools, Agricultural and Construction Machinery, Marine and Offshore Equipment.

Material: The bearing is manufactured from standard bearing steel, which ensures high durability and resistance to wear. The outer ring has a cylindrical outside surface and an optimized profile, which helps to distribute the strain on a wide contact surface and reduce contact pressure. The FG series is a track roller or support roller with needle rollers. These rolling elements combine high load capacity with a compact design. Track rollers are designed for use with various types of tracks. Thanks to a thick-walled outer ring, they can withstand high radial loads. Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. Yoke type track rollers are suitable for mounting on a shaft. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support. These bearing has a full complement design. The absence of a cage allows for a greater number of rolling elements, making this track roller radially highly loadable. Full complement track rollers are also more shock-resistant than track rollers with a cage. However, the maximum rotational speed is lower than that of caged variants. Common applications of track rollers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam mechanisms. SW=Cam Followers Without Stud With Optimized Profile.

Track rollers are designed for use with various types of tracks. Thanks to a thick-walled outer ring, they can withstand high radial loads. Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. Yoke type track rollers are suitable for mounting on a shaft. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support. This design allows for a controlled movement of the rolling elements. There is lower friction compared to full complement track rollers, allowing for higher rotational speeds and less heat generation. Common applications of support rollers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam mechanisms.

desc: CAM FOLLOWERS WITHOUT STUD WITH PIVOT AND TAPERED BEARINGS PK
tech: The PK...C series is a cam follower with cylindrical rollers. These rolling elements combine a high load capacity with reasonable shock resistance. Cam followers are designed for use with various types of tracks. Thanks to a thick-walled outer ring, they can withstand high radial loads. Instead of an inner ring, they feature a solid, threaded stud, enabling easy mounting. Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support. These bearing is equipped with a cage that prevents the rolling elements from coming into contact with each other. This design allows for a controlled movement of the rolling elements. There is lower friction compared to full complement cam followers, allowing for higher rotational speeds and less heat generation. Common applications of cam followers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam mechanisms. C=Cylindrical.

The FK...C series is a high-performance guide roller from the Heavy-Line series, specifically engineered to operate in harsh, debris-heavy environments. It utilizes tapered roller bearings to manage simultaneous high radial and axial loads that standard needle rollers cannot handle. These allow the roller to absorb significant axial thrust caused by track misalignments without compromising its primary radial function. A thick-walled outer ring designed to withstand extreme shocks and radial pressure. Material : Standard bearing steel for internal rolling elements. Features are : High Load Capacity, Shock Resistance, System Compatibility, Maintenance-Free, High-Speed Capability, Long-Life Lubrication. Applications : Foundry and Steel Production, Heavy Industrial Manufacturing, Robotics and Automation, Logistics and Warehousing, Packaging and Specialized Machinery, Textile and Paper Machinery, Woodworking Machinery. C : Indicates Compatibility With Base-Line Rails (Aluminum Body With Steel Shafts).

L : Cylindrical Outer Ring.

The GE-C bearing is a spherical plain bearing. Spherical plain bearings are two-piece plain bearings. They have no rolling elements, but consist of an inner and outer ring. The inner ring has a convex outer surface. The outer ring has a concave inner surface. This construction gives spherical plain bearings their high load carrying capacity and capacity to accommodate misalignment. These bearing has a steel-on-bronze sliding contact. The steel inner ring contacts the bronze surface of the outer ring. The steel-on-bronze sliding contact makes this bearing highly wear-resistant, providing low friction. However, the load capacity is slightly lower compared to spherical plain bearings with steel-on-steel sliding contacts. This bearing needs regular maintenance. Proper lubrication is required to reduce friction and prevent fouling and corrosion. C=Maintenance-Free.

The GE..ES bearing is a spherical plain bearing. Spherical plain bearings are two-piece plain bearings. They have no rolling elements, but consist of an inner and outer ring. The inner ring has a convex outer surface. The outer ring has a concave inner surface. This construction gives spherical plain bearings their high load carrying capacity and capacity to accommodate misalignment. These bearing has a steel-on-steel sliding contact. Both the outer and inner rings of this bearing are made of steel. Bearings with steel-on-steel sliding contacts are wear-resistant and have a high load carrying capacity. This bearing type requires regular maintenance. Proper lubrication is required to reduce friction and prevent fouling and corrosion. ES=Split Outer Ring With Lubrication Holes.

The GEZ-ES  bearing is a spherical plain bearing. Spherical plain bearings are two-piece plain bearings. They have no rolling elements, but consist of an inner and outer ring. The inner ring has a convex outer surface. The outer ring has a concave inner surface. This construction gives spherical plain bearings their high load carrying capacity and capacity to accommodate misalignment.These bearing has a steel-on-steel sliding contact. Both the outer and inner rings of this bearing are made of steel. Bearings with steel-on-steel sliding contacts are wear-resistant and have a high load carrying capacity. This bearing type requires regular maintenance. Proper lubrication is required to reduce friction and prevent fouling and corrosion. ES=Split Outer Ring With Lubrication Holes.

The FG series is a track roller or support roller with needle rollers. These rolling elements combine high load capacity with a compact design. Track rollers are designed for use with various types of tracks. Thanks to a thick-walled outer ring, they can withstand high radial loads. Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. Yoke type track rollers are suitable for mounting on a shaft. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support. These bearing has a full complement design. The absence of a cage allows for a greater number of rolling elements, making this track roller radially highly loadable. Full complement track rollers are also more shock-resistant than track rollers with a cage. However, the maximum rotational speed is lower than that of caged variants. Common applications of track rollers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam mechanisms. EE = Rubber Seal on Two Sides.

desc: Multi-Stage cylindrical roller thrust bearings(Tandem bearings) T6AR30127
tech: T6AR=The Axial Forces Are Supported By A Six-Stage Tandem Bearing T6AR Combined With An Axial Cylindrical Roller Bearing

McGill CAMROL bearings are full complement needle bearings feature black oxide treated bearing steel, available in two basic mounting styles for use in mechanical automation or linear motion applications. Full-type roller bearing CF bearing the ultimate in radial capacity, improving its load-carrying qualities to complement its resistance to shock. A soft stud stem adds toughness and permits reworking for slight dimensional changes. Holes through either side or ends of the stud provide for convenient relubrication. CF Series offer Standard Sealed and Unsealed bearings. CF - Cam Follower, Screw Driver Slot. A screw-driver slot is provided at the flanged end of the stud for the purpose of preventing the stud from turning when the nut is tightened. screw-driver slot is rounded and in some cases it may be necessary to use a special screw-driver having a rounded edge to hold the stud securely.
CF - Cam Follwer With inch Dimensions, B =  Hex Slot
CCF -  Cam Follower With Crown Od , Inch Dimensions , Screw Driver Slot

desc: CCF-S CAM FOLLOWER CROWNED O.D (UNSEALED) LUBRI-DISC SEALS
tech: McGill CAMROL bearings are full complement needle bearings feature black oxide treated bearing steel, available in two basic mounting styles for use in mechanical automation or linear motion applications. CCF -  Cam Follower With Crowned OD, B = Hex Socket. Hexagonal hole is provided in the stud face on selected sizes for use with applications involving bearings mounted in blind holes or with self-locking nuts requiring greater than average thread torque. A screw-driver slot is provided at the flanged end of the stud for the purpose of preventing the stud from turning when the nut is tightened. Screw-driver slot is rounded and in some cases it may be necessary to use a special screw-driver having a rounded edge to hold the stud securely. A crown on the OD of a cam follower bearing can increase bearing life versus a standard cylindrical cam follower. The crown also helps reduce outer skidding in turntable or rotary applications. desc: CFH SERIES HEAVY STUD CAM FOLLOWERS (UNSEALED)

CFH - Heavy Stud Cam Follower, S - Sealed Version, B - Hex Socket. Hexagonal hole is provided in the stud face on selected sizes for use with applications involving bearings mounted in blind holes or with self-locking nuts requiring greater than average thread torque. Protection & Longevity: The sealed design (LUBRI-DISC) helps retain lubricant and prevents ingress of contaminants (dust, moisture, particles), improving service life especially in harsh environments. Hex head (broached) allows convenient tool access. Pre-lubrication reduces initial maintenance needs.

desc: CCFH-S SERIES HEAVY STUD CAM FOLLOWERS WITH CROWNED O.D. & LUBRI-DISC SEALS
tech: McGill CAMROL bearings are full complement needle bearings feature black oxide treated bearing steel, available in two basic mounting styles for use in mechanical automation or linear motion applications. CCFH - Heavy Stud Cam Follower With Crown OD, S - Seal on Both Sides. “Crowned O.D.” means the outer roller surface is slightly convex (crowned) rather than perfectly cylindrical, allowing better load distribution and reducing edge (corner) stresses. These are stud-mount cam followers (i.e. they mount via a stud), with the heavy stud design. Seals retain grease and help prevent ingress in dusty or wet environments.

desc: CCFH-S SERIES HEAVY STUD CAM FOLLOWERS WITH HEX HOLE, CROWNED O.D. (SEALED)
tech: McGill CAMROL bearings are full complement needle bearings feature black oxide treated bearing steel, available in two basic mounting styles for use in mechanical automation or linear motion applications. CCFH - Heavy Stud Cam Follower With Crown OD, S - Seal on Both Sides, B - Hex Socket. Hexagonal hole is provided in the stud face on selected sizes for use with applications involving bearings mounted in blind holes or with self-locking nuts requiring greater than average thread torque. CAMROL CCFH series bearings are available with crowned O.D. Crowning of the outer race or roller surface reduces the possibility of edge loading of rollers in applications where misalignment can cause this problem. CCFH Series offer Sealed and Unsealed bearings. Cam followers with LUBRI-DISC seals.

McGill CAMROL bearings are full complement needle bearings feature black oxide treated bearing steel, available in two basic mounting styles for use in mechanical automation or linear motion applications. desc: CFH SERIES HEAVY STUD CAM FOLLOWERS (UNSEALED)
tech: McGill CAMROL bearings are full complement needle bearings feature black oxide treated bearing steel, available in two basic mounting styles for use in mechanical automation or linear motion applications. desc: PCF SERIES TRAKROL CAM FOLLOWER BEARINGS
tech: PCF Series (TRAKROL) cam follower bearings are heavy-duty, stud-type track rollers with plain cylindrical outer surfaces, designed for combined radial + thrust loads, shock loading, track or cam type applications. They feature black oxide finish bearing steel, sealed design (in many sizes), heavy section outer race and quality insert (ball or tapered roller) depending on size. Typical uses include machine tool tracks, heavy automation equipment, conveyors, indexing machines, cam drives and other systems requiring a follower that can roll along a track or face under moderate to heavy load.

desc: PCFE SERIES TRAKROL CAM FOLLOWER BEARINGS- ECCENTRIC
tech: PCFE Series (TRAKROL) cam follower bearings are stud-mounted, cylindrical OD roller bearings designed primarily for track or follower applications, in the “plain OD” (no groove, no flange) category, with features such as: Eccentric stud version (PCFE) option for radial position adjustment, Ball bearing inserts (for many sizes) and sealed versions, Black oxide finish and heavy section outer race. The eccentric stud version allows fine adjustment of roller position, helpful in applications where load sharing, alignment or compensation for wear is needed.

desc: FCYR SERIES TRAKROL CAM FOLLOWER BEARINGS
tech: FCYR Yoke-mounted track rollers with a flanged outer diameter is capable of handling large radial + axial (thrust) loads built with heavy-section outer race, black oxide finish, precision inserts, designed for relatively high load, moderate speed track / cam / conveyor / guide applications. Because the configuration is yoke mount, ensure your mounting arrangement provides a hardened shaft or rail, and proper clearance/fit in the yoke arms. The bore or shaft needs to be suited for the bearing’s inner ring. The flanged OD helps guide the roller laterally (for example in guiding a track or rail). But the cylindrical OD with flange still demands good track contact, alignment and surface finish. Misalignment or uneven loading can shorten life.

desc: VCF SERIES TRAKROL CAM FOLLOWER BEARINGS
tech: VCF Series (TRAKROL) cam follower bearings are stud-mounted, V-grooved roller types designed for V-track guidance applications with moderate to heavy loads (radial + thrust). They feature robust construction (heavy housing, sealed, black oxide finish), and are designed for durable use in industrial motion applications where side loads or guidance tracks matter. Because of the V-groove OD, these are ideal for V-shaped track or rail guidance systems (e.g., conveyors with V-rails, rollers in V-tracks, etc). The V-groove helps guide the roller and reduces side-slip or misalignment.

desc: VCFE SERIES TRAKROL CAM FOLLOWER BEARINGS- ECCENTRIC
tech: VCFE Cam follower Stud type V -Grooved outside Diameter with insert type Ball  . Outer dia meter is V- Grooved with rubber lip seal .They have Polyurreas Grease with Eccentric type & hex hole. Special duty cam followers with V-groove O.D.\'s and integral seals. Ball bearings are used for roller diameters or point diameters (VCF series) less than 3 and tapered roller bearings for roller diameters and point diameters 3 and larger. These constructions make possible successful bearing operation with various combinations of radial and thrust loads. V-grooved bearings are designed to operate on \"V\"-bar tracks. This bearing and track arrangement is used to reduce buildup of contamination, such as sand, powder, chips, etc., which would be likely to occur if flat tracks were employed.

Ball bearings are used for roller diameters or point diameters (VCF series) less than 3 and tapered roller bearings for roller diameters and point diameters 3 and larger. These constructions make possible successful bearing operation with various combinations of radial and thrust loads. V-grooved bearings are designed to operate on \"V\"-bar tracks. This bearing and track arrangement is used to reduce buildup of contamination, such as sand, powder, chips, etc., which would be likely to occur if flat tracks were employed.

desc: CYRD SERIES HEAVY DUTY CAM YOKE ROLLER (SEALED)
tech: McGill CAMROL bearings are full complement needle bearings feature black oxide treated bearing steel, available in two basic mounting styles for use in mechanical automation or linear motion applications. CYRD = Heavy Duty Cam Yoke Roller With cylindrical OD, Rubber Seal on Both side. These series provide improved thrust capability versus the above needle rolling element and bushing type designs. They are designed using a double row of full complement cylindrical rolling elements. Their construction helps to support incidental thrust sometimes associated with cam follower and track roller applications. The cylindrical OD can improve performance in certain applications such as improved track capacity by maximizing the contact area with the track.

desc: CYRD SERIES HEAVY DUTY CAM YOKE ROLLER (SEALED) - CROWNED O.D.
tech: McGill CAMROL bearings are full complement needle bearings feature black oxide treated bearing steel, available in two basic mounting styles for use in mechanical automation or linear motion applications. CCYRD =  Heavy Duty Cam Yoke Roller With Crowned OD, Rubber Seal on Both side. A crown on the OD of a cam follower bearing can increase bearing life versusa standard cylindrical cam follower. The crown achieves this performance by helping to distribute the stress on the outer ring and rolling elements resulting from misalignment due to mounting inaccuracy or stud deflection. The crown also helps reduce outer skidding in turntable or rotary applications.

desc: MCFD SERIES FULL COMPLIMENT CAM FOLLOWERS- HEAVY DUTY (SHIELDED)
tech: The CAMROL bearing series MCFD Metric bearings, which provide greater basic dynamic load ratings by utilizing cylindrical rollers in place of standard needle rollers. This construction allows the bearings to take heavier axial loading. MCFD = Heavy Duty Cam Follower Metric Size, Crowned OD, Screw Driver slot, Metal Seals on Both Side. A screw-driver slot is provided at the flanged end of the stud for the purpose of preventing the stud from turning when the nut is tightened. screw-driver slot is rounded and in some cases it may be necessary to use a special screw-driver having a rounded edge to hold the stud securely. Black oxide finish on all exposed surfaces for maximum corrosion resistance.

desc: MCFDE METRIC HEAVY DUTY CAM FOLLOWER- ECCENTRIC BUSHING (SEALED)
tech: McGill CAMROL bearings are full complement needle bearings feature black oxide treated bearing steel, available in two basic mounting styles for use in mechanical automation or linear motion applications. MCFDE= Heavy Duty Cam Follower Metric Size With Eccentric Bush, Crowned OD, Screw Driver slot, Metal Seals on Both Side. A screw-driver slot is provided at the flanged end of the stud for the purpose of preventing the stud from turning when the nut is tightened. screw-driver slot is rounded and in some cases it may be necessary to use a special screw-driver having a rounded edge to hold the stud securely. Eccentric bushing is press fit on stud and unhardened to permit dowel or setscrew for permanent locking. The crown achieves this performance byhelping to distribute the stress on the outer ring and rolling elements resulting from misalignment due to mounting inaccuracy or stud deflection.

desc: MCFD-X SERIES FULL COMPLIMENT CAM FOLLOWERS- HEAVY DUTY (SHIELDED)
tech: The CAMROL bearing series MCFD Metric bearings, which provide greater basic dynamic load ratings by utilizing cylindrical rollers in place of standard needle rollers. This construction allows the bearings to take heavier axial loading. MCFD = Heavy Duty Cam Follower Metric Size, X = Cylindrical OD, Screw Driver slot, Metal Seals on Both Side. The cylindrical OD can improve performance in certain applications such as improved track capacity by maximizing the contact area with the track. Cylindrical OD is standard for Inch Series. Cylindrical OD is and option for Metric Series. A screw-driver slot is provided at the flanged end of the stud for the purpose of preventing the stud from turning when the nut is tightened. Black oxide finish on all exposed surfaces for maximum corrosion resistance. All bearings also available with a cylindrical outside diameter instead of the standard 500mm crown radius. Lubri-DiscSeal provides protection against contaminants and loss of lubricant, reduces internal bearing friction — increases bearing life and improves performance.

desc: MCFDE METRIC HEAVY DUTY CAM FOLLOWER- ECCENTRIC BUSHING (SEALED)

These are yoke-mount (shaft mount) rollers rather than stud-type, designed for high radial loads, shock loads, and track/guide applications. MCYRD = Heavy Duty Cam Yoke Roller, X =  Cylindrical OD, Metric size, Rubber Seal on Both side. The cylindrical OD can improve performance in certain applications such as improved track capacity by maximizing the contact area with the track. These are yoke-mount (shaft mount) rollers rather than stud-type, designed for high radial loads, shock loads, and track/guide applications. Applications : Track rollers / guide rollers in heavy duty conveyors, material handling systems.

desc: MCYRR METRIC CAM FOLLOWER - CAGE TYPE (UNSEALED)
tech: The MCYRR Series by McGill represents a line of metric yoke-type cam followers engineered for heavy-duty applications where smooth rolling, high load capacity, and long service life are required. The “RR” suffix designates a “Double Row” (dual raceway) or reinforced roller design, providing greater radial load capacity and improved stability compared to standard single-row cam followers. Applications : Cam indexing mechanisms, Conveyors and transfer systems, Textile and packaging machinery, Robotics and automation lines, High-load track roller systems etc.

desc: MCYRR-S SERIES METRIC CAMROL BEARING - CAGE TYPE (SEALED)
tech: The MCYRR-S Series from McGill is a sealed metric yoke-type cam follower designed for heavy-duty applications where high radial loads, long service life, and contamination protection are required. The “RR” indicates double-row needle roller construction, providing higher load capacity and improved rigidity, while the “-S” suffix denotes double-lip contact seals to retain grease and exclude dirt, dust, and moisture. Applications : Cam indexing mechanisms, Conveyor systems and track rollers, Packaging, printing, and textile machinery, Robotics and automation lines, Material handling and transfer machinery etc.

desc: MCYR SERIES METRIC CAM FOLLOWER - FULL COMPLEMENT (UNSEALED)
tech: The MCYR Series from McGill represents a line of metric yoke-type cam followers engineered for high radial load capacity, smooth operation, and long service life in demanding motion systems. These cam followers use full complement needle roller construction within a thick-walled outer ring, providing exceptional strength and rigidity for use in cam, track, and linear motion applications. Applications : Cam drives and indexing equipment, Conveyor and material handling systems, Automation equipment, Linear and rotary motion mechanisms, Packaging and printing machinery etc.

desc: MCYR-S SERIES METRIC CAM FOLLOWER - FULL COMPLEMENT (SEALED)
tech: The MCYR-S Series from McGill is a line of metric yoke-type cam followers designed with integrated seals (“-S”) for enhanced protection against contaminants. desc: MCFR SERIES METRIC CAMROL CAGE TYPE (UNSEALED) BEARING

desc: MCF-A SERIES METRIC CAMROL FULL COMPLEMENT (UNSEALED) BEARING
tech: The MCF prefix designates the Metric CAMROL series of stud-type cam followers (i.e. they have a threaded stud mounting). The “A” suffix indicates Asian dimensional standard (as opposed to European / ISO standard metric). This means some dimensions (stud diameter, thread pitch, lengths etc.) conform to Asian metric norms. Thus MCF-A is the stud cam follower in metric sizes with Asian standard dimensions. The crowned outer diameter helps reduce stress concentrations when there is slight misalignment or track deformation. Full complement needle rollers provide high radial load capacity, which is efficient for bearing heavy loads in compact spaces. Black oxide finish gives better corrosion resistance on external surfaces.

These bearings are designed to provide anti-friction support for linear movement or to follow the surface of a cam, offering a broad range of designs to suit various applications. The \"S\" designation indicates that these cam followers come with a LUBRI-DISC seal, which helps retain lubrication and exclude contaminants, enhancing bearing life and performance. The outer race is slightly convex, allowing for better alignment and load distribution, which is particularly beneficial in applications with slight misalignment. The MCFR-S series features a stud-type mounting, facilitating easy installation and adjustment in various applications. High radial load capacity in a compact form factor.

desc: MCF-A SERIES METRIC CAMROL FULL COMPLEMENT (UNSEALED) BEARING
tech: The MCF prefix designates the Metric CAMROL series of stud-type cam followers (i.e. they have a threaded stud mounting). The “A” suffix indicates Asian dimensional standard (as opposed to European / ISO standard metric). This means some dimensions (stud diameter, thread pitch, lengths etc.) conform to Asian metric norms. Thus MCF-A is the stud cam follower in metric sizes with Asian standard dimensions. The crowned outer diameter helps reduce stress concentrations when there is slight misalignment or track deformation. Full complement needle rollers provide high radial load capacity, which is efficient for bearing heavy loads in compact spaces. Black oxide finish gives better corrosion resistance on external surfaces.

desc: MCF SERIES METRIC CAMROL FULL COMPLEMENT (UNSEALED) BEARING
tech: The metric stud type MCF bearings share all the same features and range of options as other CAMROL bearings. Each Cam Follower is supplied with two nuts and appropriate metric threads, the second nut is intended to serve as a locknut. All designs use the patented LUBRI-DISC seals that provide protection against contamination and loss of lubricant. LUBRI-DISC seals reduce internal bearing friction — bearings wear less and last longer. Integral inner studs on MCF cam followers are designed for cantilever mounting. Extended end of the inner stud is threaded, screwdriver slot on flange end holds the stud stationary while tightening the nut during mounting. Two nuts with metric threads. The second nut serves as a locknut. Black oxide finish on all exposed surfaces for maximum corrosion resistance. All bearings also available with a cylindrical outside diameter instead of the standard 500mm crown radius. Lubri-Disc Seal provides protection against contaminants and loss of lubricant, reduces internal bearing friction — increases bearing life and improves performance. MCF Series offer Sealed and Unsealed bearings.

The \"S\" designation indicates that these cam followers come with a LUBRI-DISC® seal, which helps retain lubrication and exclude contaminants, enhancing bearing life and performance. The outer race is slightly convex, allowing for better alignment and load distribution, which is particularly beneficial in applications with slight misalignment. High radial load capacity in a compact form factor. The MCF-S series features a stud-type mounting, facilitating easy installation and adjustment in various applications.

desc: FULL COMPLEMENT ROLLER WITH OUTER DIAMETER
tech: The FGU bearing is a ball-bearing Yoke type track roller, of which the rolling elements combine low friction with high precision. Track rollers are designed for use with various types of tracks. Thanks to a thick-walled outer ring, they can withstand high radial loads. Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. Yoke type track rollers are suitable for mounting on a shaft. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support. This design allows for a controlled movement of the rolling elements. There is lower friction compared to full complement track rollers, allowing for higher rotational speeds and less heat generation. Common applications of support rollers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam mechanisms. MM : Metal Shields.

The Nadella GCR series is a cam follower with needle rollers. These rolling elements combine high load capacity with a compact design. Cam followers are designed for use with various types of tracks. Thanks to a thick-walled outer ring, they can withstand high radial loads. Instead of an inner ring, they feature a solid, threaded stud, enabling easy mounting. Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support. The GCR22 Nadella has a full complement design. The absence of a cage allows for a greater number of rolling elements, making this cam follower radially highly loadable. Full complement cam followers are also more shock-resistant than cam followers with a cage. However, the maximum rotational speed is lower than that of caged variants. Common applications of cam followers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam mechanisms.

GLYCODUR F sliding bearings have a steel base, to which a 0.2 to 0.4 mm porous tin bronze layer is sintered. The pores of this layer are filled during a rolling process with polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) and other friction and wear reducing additives. GLYCODUR F sliding bearings combine in optimal manner the mechanical properties of the sintered bronze with the sliding and lubrication properties of a PTFE mixture. The structure of this composite material results in good dimensional stability and good thermal conductivity. GLYCODUR F bearings cover a much larger temperature range between -200 to +260 °C (-328 to +500 °F). This large range results from the special material combination used for the sliding layer with its excellent heat conductivity.

desc: MCFR-SBX METRIC CAMROL CAGE TYPE (SEALED) BEARING
tech: The McGill MCFR - SBX is a metric stud-type cam follower from the CAMROL series, designed for applications requiring high-speed and moderate radial load capacities. Its needle roller bearing design makes it ideal where reduced friction, precise guidance, and durability are required. Needle Roller Bearings: Provide high load capacity and reduced friction. Sealed Design: Prevents contamination and retains lubrication, enhancing service life. Hex Hole Head: Facilitates secure mounting and easy installation. LUBRI-DISC  Seal: Offers superior sealing capabilities, ensuring long-term performance. Applications: Automation & Robotics, Material Handling, Machine Tooling, Packaging & Food Processing etc. S = Sealed (LUBRI-DISC), B = Full complement cylindrical roller (basic stud-type design), X = Cylindrical cam follower with flat rollers.
2RS - Rubber Seal on Two Sides

The McGill MI series inner races is a hardened and precision-ground steel ring designed to serve as the inner raceway for needle roller bearings, specifically in applications where the shaft cannot be heat-treated to the necessary hardness or finish. The MI series inner rings are designed to be fully compatible with McGill\'s Cagerol (caged roller) and Guiderol  (full complement roller) needle bearings, providing flexibility in application design. Applications : Automotive and Transportation Systems, Pumps and Compressors, Printing Machinery, Machine Tools, Conveyor Systems, Agricultural Equipment. N : Narrow Width.

desc: Precision WINKEL Bearing Axial Bearing Fixed (Combined Roller + Plate, Welded)
tech:
The WINKEL 4.054 + AP 0‑Q is a combined roller bearing that supports both radial and axial loads. Its axial component is adjustable, allowing fine-tuning via an eccentric, multi-position shaft screw (8 positions). It offers efficient load handling and simplifies assembly in precision linear systems.

Compared to the standard AP 0 flange, the AP 0‑Q variant is slightly lighter (≈ 0.28 kg) but features the same installation height (~30.5 mm) and compatibility with the same shims (DS‑0‑0.5 mm or DS‑0‑1.0 mm)

The 4.054 + AP 0‑Q is a precision combined bearing ideal for applications requiring:


	Adjustable axial preload or clearance
	Reliable radial and thrust load support in one compact unit
	Easy assembly and maintenance
	Durable performance under standard industrial temperature and speed ranges

4.055  WINKEL Bearing axial bearing fixed

combined roller
tech:
WINKEL Bearing axial bearing fixed  Type 4.055
Article No. 200.002.000

The WINKEL 4.054 is a fixed axial–radial combined bearing designed to support both radial and axial loads simultaneously. It's commonly used in applications such as forklift masts, lifting equipment, and automated handling systems.
 

FEATURES:


	Combined Load Handling: Integrates radial and axial load support in a single unit, optimizing space and simplifying design.
	Full Complement Cylindrical Rollers: Provides high load capacity and durability.
	Relubricatable Design: Allows for maintenance and extended service life.
	Modular Mounting: Compatible with various mounting flanges (e.g., AP 0, AP 0-Q), facilitating easy integration into different systems.
	Sealing System: ZRS seals protect against contaminants and retain lubrication effectively.

tech:
This is the fixed-type axial combined bearing (Type 4.054) welded to the AP 0 flange plate, forming a single, ready-to-install unit.

WINKEL Combined Bearings are precision-engineered components used in linear motion systems to simultaneously handle radial and axial (thrust) loads. They are designed for heavy-duty applications and are typically used in vertical and horizontal guiding systems (e.g., lift masts, handling equipment, and industrial automation).

4.054: This is the model number for a WINKEL axial bearing. It's part of a series of bearings designed for high radial and axial loads, with options for different sizes and features.

AP 0: This is a flange plate designed to be welded or bolted to the 4.054 bearing, providing a mounting surface for integration into a system.

tech: The GEBK-S bearing is a spherical plain bearing. Spherical plain bearings are two-piece plain bearings. They have no rolling elements, but consist of an inner and outer ring. The inner ring has a convex outer surface. The outer ring has a concave inner surface. This construction gives spherical plain bearings their high load carrying capacity and capacity to accommodate misalignment. These bearing has a steel-on-bronze sliding contact. The steel inner ring contacts the bronze surface of the outer ring. The steel-on-bronze sliding contact makes this bearing highly wear-resistant, providing low friction. However, the load capacity is slightly lower compared to spherical plain bearings with steel-on-steel sliding contacts. This bearing needs regular maintenance. Proper lubrication is required to reduce friction and prevent fouling and corrosion. S=Steel-On-Steel.

The GCUR bearing is a cam follower with needle rollers. These rolling elements combine high load capacity with a compact design. Cam followers are designed for use with various types of tracks. Thanks to a thick-walled outer ring, they can withstand high radial loads. Instead of an inner ring, they feature a solid, threaded stud, enabling easy mounting. Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support. These bearing has a full complement design. The absence of a cage allows for a greater number of rolling elements, making this cam follower radially highly loadable. Full complement cam followers are also more shock-resistant than cam followers with a cage. However, the maximum rotational speed is lower than that of caged variants. Common applications of cam followers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam mechanisms. MM=Metal Seals At Each Side Of The Bearing.

The SKF Motor Encoder Unit is a compact, integrated unit consisting of:
• A pre-lubricated SKF Explorer deep groove ball bearing in the 62 series with a snap ring groove in the outer ring and an RS1 contact seal
• An impulse ring
• A sensor body
• A cable outlet and connecting cable
The impulse ring, which attaches to the inner ring of the bearing, is a composite magnetized ring that contains between 32 and 80 north and south poles. The sensor body, which is attached to the outer ring, protects the patented SKF Hall effect cells. The multiwire connecting cable extends in the radial direction.The bearing is protected by a contact seal on one side. On the opposite side of the bearing, the impulse ring and sensor body create an effective labyrinth seal to keep 
lubricant in and solid contaminants out of the Bearing

The GAC-S bearing is a spherical plain bearing. Spherical plain bearings are two-piece plain bearings. They have no rolling elements, but consist of an inner and outer ring. The inner ring has a convex outer surface. The outer ring has a concave inner surface. This construction gives spherical plain bearings their high load carrying capacity and capacity to accommodate misalignment. These bearing has a steel-on-steel sliding contact. Both the outer and inner rings of this bearing are made of steel. Bearings with steel-on-steel sliding contacts are wear-resistant and have a high load carrying capacity. This bearing type requires regular maintenance. Proper lubrication is required to reduce friction and prevent fouling and corrosion. S=Steel-On-Steel.

The GAC..T bearing is a metric, maintenance-free angular contact spherical plain bearing designed to handle combined radial and axial loads. It features a self-lubricating design with a PTFE fabric liner, making it suitable for applications where regular lubrication is difficult or impossible. Material : Both the inner and outer rings are made from GCr15 bearing steel, hardened to HRC 58-64 for maximum structural integrity. The outer ring is manganese phosphated to prevent rust, while the inner ring\'s sliding surface is hard chrome plated to reduce friction and wear. Features are : Environmental Stability, Oscillating Motion, Maintenance-Free Desgin, Shock & Vibration Damping, Reduced Total Cost of Ownership, Alignment Flexibility. Applications : Construction & Mining, Agricultural Machinery, Automotive & Heavy Trucks, Renewable Energy, Robotics & Automation, Material Handling, Machine Tool Spindles, Marine and Offshore, Food and Beverage Packaging, Semiconductor Manufacturing. T=Contact Material Steel on PTFE.

The McGill CYR-1 1/2-20 is an inch-series, open (unsealed), yoke-type cam follower (track roller) manufactured from high-grade chrome steel. It is designed for applications with heavy radial loads and uses a full complement of needle rollers to provide high dynamic and static load ratings within standard dimensions. A yoke roller is mounted on a separate shaft or pin within a yoke or housing. Features are : Relubrication capability, Shock load resistance, Corrosion Resistance, Operating Temperature Range, Low Friction at High Speeds. Applications : Conveyor systems, Automated machinery, Packaging equipment, Robotics, Machine tools, Textile machinery, Printing machinery, Automotive assembly lines, Construction equipment, Agricultural machinery.

The Nadella GC...EE series is a cam follower with needle rollers. These rolling elements combine high load capacity with a compact design. Cam followers are designed for use with various types of tracks. Thanks to a thick-walled outer ring, they can withstand high radial loads. Instead of an inner ring, they feature a solid, threaded stud, enabling easy mounting. Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support. This bearing has a full complement design. The absence of a cage allows for a greater number of rolling elements, making this cam follower radially highly loadable. Full complement cam followers are also more shock-resistant than cam followers with a cage. However, the maximum rotational speed is lower than that of caged variants. Common applications of cam followers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam mechanisms. EE : Plastic Seals At Each Side Of The Bearing.

desc: GUIDE ROLLERS PFV WITH GOTHIC ARCH PROFILE
tech: THREAD (M8 x 1.25). The PFV bearing is a ball-bearing stud type track roller or cam follower, of which the rolling elements combine low friction with high precision. Cam followers are designed for use with various types of tracks. Thanks to a thick-walled outer ring, they can withstand high radial loads. Instead of an inner ring, they feature a solid, threaded stud, enabling easy mounting. Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support. These bearing has a full complement design. The absence of a cage allows for a greater number of rolling elements, making this cam follower radially highly loadable. Full complement cam followers are also more shock-resistant than cam followers with a cage. However, the maximum rotational speed is lower than that of caged variants. Common applications of cam followers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam mechanisms.

The RKO bearing is a specific Nadella guide roller designed for use in the brand\'s linear guide systems, particularly the \"Base-Line\" series for light to medium loads. It is a self-retained construction unit with a thick-walled outer ring to absorb high radial forces and some axial loads. Material : The rolling elements and outer ring are made from through-hardened, high-carbon chromium steel for durability and heat tolerance under heavy loads. Features are : Self-Retained Unit, High Rigidity & Precision, Low Friction, High-Speed Operation, Shock Resistance, Maintenance-Free Design, Ease of Mounting, Misalignment Compensation. Applications : Machine Tools & Metalwork, Packaging & Assembly, Robotics & Automation, Printing Machinery, Woodworking Machines, Foundry & Steel Mill Equipment, Agricultural Technology, Electronic & Medical Equipment.

The RKOR bearing is a specific guide roller (cam follower) with a tapered roller bearing, designed for use in heavy-duty linear motion systems. The RKO designation likely stands for a concentric guide roller with a \"gothic arch\" profile outer ring, while the R in similar parts (RKUR) denotes an eccentric version. The robust construction with a thick-walled outer ring and tapered rollers allows it to withstand high radial and significant axial loads simultaneously. Materials :  The rollers are manufactured from high-quality bearing steel that undergoes induction hardening (typically to 58 HRC) and precision grinding to ensure extreme surface hardness and durability. Features are : Maintenance-Free Operation, High Load Capacity, Low Noise & Smoothness, High-Speed Stability, Misalignment Compensation, High Load Tapered Roller Bearing. Applications : Robotics & Automation, Foundry & Steel Fabrication, Material Handling, Packaging Machinery, Mining & Quarrying Equipment,

Radial spherical plain bearings are designed to accommodate radial and combined radial and axial loads, and also misalignment. These bearings have a customized design. It utilizes a steel-on-PTFE fabric sliding contact. During an initial break-in period, PTFE particles fill surface irregularities to create a smooth, low-friction interface that requires no relubrication. The inner ring features a convex outer surface that slides within the concave inner surface of the outer ring. This allows the bearing to compensate for shaft deflections and mounting inaccuracies. Material : Both the inner and outer rings are made from high-quality bearing steel for maximum durability. Features are : Heavy Load Capacity, Versatile Motion Support, High-Stiffness, Self-Lubricating Mechanism, Misalignment Correction, Normal Tolerance, Extended Service Life. Applications : Mining and Metals, Construction Equipment, Power Transmission, Wind Energy, Material Handling Linkages, Offshore Cranes.

tech: KMF Needle Roller OD =  3, LENGTH = 15.8, RANGE OF USE SHAFT DIAMETER = 100. Radial Needle Roller and cage assemblies consist of plastic cage strips for needle rollers, produced as yardgoods and filled with rollers. Seven types of needle roller sizes between 1.5 mm diam. to 12 mm diam. are available, and are either offered spooled as yardgoods or cut to required length ready for installation. The needle rollers (NRB) are contained and guided in the roller pockets and are in accordance with DIN 5402 / ISA 3096.The temperature limits of the radial needle roller and cage assembly rings in the standard version incontinuous operation are –40°C and +100°C, in short-term operation the upper limit is +120°C.

The Nadella GCL32D01 is a full-complement, stud-type cam follower designed for heavy-duty industrial motion applications. It features a cylindrical outer ring and is an open bearing (without seals), making it suitable for environments where it can be regularly lubricated. Material : Made from high-strength, hardened bearing steel, the component is designed for durability and a long lifespan. Features are : Maximum Load Capacity, Reduced Friction through Design, Precision Heat Treatment, Interchangeability, Maintenance-Friendly Lubrication, Axial Load Tolerance, Re-lubrication Capability. Applications : Automated machinery and positioners, Cam mechanisms, Conveyor and material handling systems, Linear guidance systems and slide ways, Printing and Stamping Equipment, Textile Machinery, Aerospace Manufacturing, Wood and Paper Industry. D01 :  Unsealed, standard version.

desc: FULL COMPLEMENT ROLLER WITH OUTER DIAMETER
tech: The FGU bearing is a ball-bearing Yoke type track roller, of which the rolling elements combine low friction with high precision. Track rollers are designed for use with various types of tracks. Thanks to a thick-walled outer ring, they can withstand high radial loads. Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. Yoke type track rollers are suitable for mounting on a shaft. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support. This design allows for a controlled movement of the rolling elements. There is lower friction compared to full complement track rollers, allowing for higher rotational speeds and less heat generation. Common applications of support rollers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam mechanisms.

Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. Yoke type track rollers are suitable for mounting on a shaft. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support. This design allows for a controlled movement of the rolling elements. There is lower friction compared to full complement track rollers, allowing for higher rotational speeds and less heat generation. Common applications of support rollers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam mechanisms.

tech: TECMA DRIVES light series of slewing rings comply with international standards, requirements and are approved for different simple and complex applications. Slewing rings are composed of two rings, one inner and one outer, in which raceway are obtained that contain rolling elements on which the working loads are transmitted from the moving ring to the fixed one. They should be transported and stored horizontally or on specially adapted incline frames. The operating temperature of our slewing rings ranges from -25ºC to + 60ºC. Light surface corrosion may occur in humid conditions, but it can be easily removed from the external surface. It is very important that the raceways are well greased to remain rust free. slewing rings are pre-lubricated with grease. E = External gear teeth, C = Light standard version.

The PFD bearing is a specific model of cam follower with a stud and a double row of full complement needle rollers, designed for high load capacity and precision in industrial applications. Its design includes a convex outer ring to accommodate potential misalignment. Features a heavy section outer ring with an optimized convex profile to support significant loads, minimize deformation risks, and compensate for minor parallelism errors between the roller and the track. Utilizes a full complement of needle rollers, which guarantees maximum load capacity and rigidity compared to caged designs. Material: The bearing is typically made of bearing steel. Applications : Automatic Machinery & Tooling, Medical & Precision Equipment, Material Handling & Logistics, Packaging & Printing, Textile & Paper Production, Food Processing, Aerospace & Robotics, Automotive Manufacturing.
