This design is commonly used in cam and track following applications where the ability to compensate for misalignment or shaft deflection is required and a specific and consistent orientation of the bearing relative to the cam or track is needed. The V-groove allows for positive guidance and helps to maintain the proper orientation of the bearing, while the eccentric stud provides the ability to adjust for misalignment, making it suitable for use in applications with shaft deflection or other sources of misalignment. The stud allows for easy installation, and the plain (non-flanged) outer surface provides minimal axial height, making it suitable for applications with tight installation constraints. The OSBORN charging roller with eccentric bolt with slot V is used for radial and axial loads. It has vertical adjustment.\nLoad rollers are robust assemblies of carefully fabricated outer shells/treads and precision bearings fitted to high tolerance shafts. Cam and support roller is a rolling element that can be part of the bearings. It is usually made of different materials such as steel, ceramic or plastic.

desc: GUIDE ROLLERS WITH TAPERED ROLLER BEARINGS
tech: The RKYR-NX Nadella bearing is a robust, stainless-steel, corrosion-resistant cam follower (guide roller) designed for linear guidance systems, featuring a thick outer ring for high radial loads, a threaded stud for easy mounting, and internal tapered roller bearings for combined radial/axial support, ideal for V-Line systems in demanding industrial environments. The \'NX\' suffix signifies stainless steel construction, enhancing its durability, especially in corrosive conditions, with standard NBR seals. Material : Stainless steel for corrosion resistance (external parts) with standard bearing steel rollers. Concentric (RKYR) with an internal tapered roller bearing, allowing it to handle significant radial and axial loads. Applications : Conveyor systems, linear motion, cam mechanisms, and general industrial automation requiring reliable, high-load linear guidance.

desc: LR SERIES DOUBLE ROW TRACK ROLLER BEARINGS
tech: The bearing is a ball-bearing Yoke type track roller, of which the rolling elements combine low friction with high precision. Track rollers are designed for use with various types of tracks. Thanks to a thick-walled outer ring, they can withstand high radial loads. Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. Yoke type track rollers are suitable for mounting on a shaft. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support. This bearing is equipped with a cage that prevents the rolling elements from coming into contact with each other. This design allows for a controlled movement of the rolling elements. There is lower friction compared to full complement track rollers, allowing for higher rotational speeds and less heat generation. Common applications of support rollers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam mechanisms. 2HRS - Lip Seals On Both Sides Made From Nitrile Butadiene Rubber, TVH - Moulded Polyamide Cage Snap-Type, Rolling Element Riding, XL - X-Life.

GUIDE CARRIAGE FOR TRACK ROLLER BEARING
tech: The Nadella BL series is a Rolbloc carriage, or block, that is a core component of a heavy-duty linear guide system. It is designed for industrial applications requiring high load capacity, robustness, and performance in harsh environments. The carriage body, made of burnished steel, houses four guide rollers which are equipped with tapered rollers, similar to PK type flat roller guides. Material : Burnished steel body. Features are : High Load Capacity, Shock & Impact Resistance, Misalignment Compensation, Environmental Suitability. Applications : Automatic Warehouses, Steel Manufacturing, Material Handling and Automation, Machine Tools & Woodworking, Packaging & Printing Machines, Foundry and Steel Fabrication.

This makes them ideal for applications such as jib cranes or where the dominant load is radial in nature such as winches or heavy industrial turnover jigs. The addition of an internal gear facilitates the transmission of power.

desc: MALE THREAD ROD ENDS BEARING (LEFT HAND THREAD)
tech: THREAD= M6, Left Hand Thread Rod Ends according to DIN ISO 12240-4 dimension series E. Mating materials: Steel on steel, Maintenance required. Inner ring: Antifriction bearing steel, hardened, ground. Outer ring: Antifriction bearing steel, hardened, ground. Outer ring is split for assembly of inner ring. Housing: Made of steel, all sizes galvanized and chormatised. The spherical bearing is pressed into the housing and caulked at both sides. All Askubal spherical bearings and rod ends can be used without restriction in an operating temperature range of between -10 °C bis +80 °C. All are very high precision, ready-to-fit bearing elements.

These type of Bearings typically require maintenance, meaning they need lubrication to function properly and prevent wear. These are usually made of steel or steel-on-steel, providing good wear resistance and load-carrying capacity.

desc: PRECISION LOCK NUT WITH LOCKING PINS
tech: M25x1.5 (THREAD SIZE) KMTA precision lock nuts have a cylindrical outside surface and are intended for applications where high precision, simple assembly and reliable locking are required. The three equally-spaced locking pins enable these lock nuts to be accurately positioned at right angles to the shaft. However, they can also be adjusted to compensate for slight angular deviations of adjacent components. No keyway Required, Withstands high axial loads. Reliable, effective locking mechanism. Designed for frequent and simple installation and removal.

ETP-TECHNO is very easy to mount with only one screw, and it also has extremely good concentricity & is the one to choose among the ETP hub-shaft connections when very high precision is needed.

In the flange there are three threaded connections (\\\"ON\\\", \\\"P\\\" and \\\"OFF\\\") in the radial direction and the same in the axial. This makes it possible to choose radial or axial connection of the pump hoses, depending on the build-in situation. Ideally suited to work in difficult environments and heavy operations like steel rolling mills, process industries etc. ETP-HYLOC is fast to mount, has good concentricity and can take high torque and radial loads. Mounting and dismantling is easily carried out with a hydraulic pump.

ETP-POWER is available as standard for shafts 15 – 40 mm. Runout ≤ 0,03 mm. Number of mountings 200 - 500 (size dependent).  ETP-POWER combines quick mounting with a high radial load capacity due to the specially developed pressure medium. ETP-POWER is a hydraulic connection with the highest performance among the single screw ETP hub-shaft connections. ETP-POWER is a hydraulic connection which consists of a double-walled hardened steel sleeve filled with a specially developed pressure medium and a flange. The flange part contains screw and piston with seals to maintain pressure. In the flange there are two pre-machined bores which can be used for mounting location pins, screws to the hub or similar.

Corrosion resistant and low maintenance, Low Mass, Easy to install.

subName: Cage Strips Filled with Ball (Ball Cages)
tech: (Series KKLK Ball Cage Tape Filled With Balls) Linear ball cages of series KKLK are pure plastic cage tapes which were mostly taken from thestandard range (roller bearing cages) for the linear area. The cage tapes are made in metre lengthsand are specially made by a separate tempering process for linear applications in greater lengths.Ball cages of series KKLK have ball pockets with ball guides and supports. They are offered includingthe balls, in metre lengths or ready to install. The standard balls for filled linear ball cages are madeaccording to DIN 5401 / Grade 15 (Class 2) of 100 Cr6 material.

desc: RADIAL ROLLER AND CAGE ASSEMBLY (TYPE SERIES KKBF)
tech: Radial Roller And Cage Assemblies are produced in compound construction. Stable precision steel wire rings, so-called supports, are completed by a plastic roller cage strip to form a radial roller and cage assembly and are filled with cylindrical rollers. The cylindrical rollers (ZRB) according to DIN 5402 / ISO 3096 are contained and guided in the roller pockets. 5 types with roller sizes between 4 mm diam. and 18 mm diam. are available. The area of use includes shaft diameters between 100 and about 1800 mm. The temperature limits of the radial needle rings in the standard version in continuous operation are between –40°C and + 100°C, in short-term operation the upper limit is +120°C.

The cylindrical rollers (ZRB) according to DIN 5402 / ISO 3096 are contained and guided in the roller pockets. 5 types with roller sizes between 4 mm diam. and 18 mm diam. are available. The area of use includes shaft diameters between 100 and about 1800 mm. The temperature limits of the radial needle rings in the standard version in continuous operation are between –40°C and + 100°C, in short-term operation the upper limit is +120°C.

Radial Roller Bearings of type KEBF consist of radial needle roller or radial roller and cage assembly of type KKBF, each in a hardened inner or outer running track. Five preferred types with spaces for installation of 15 x 8.8mm to 40.4 x 16mm are available. The material of the running rings is hardened CK 65 steel. This type series is defined by its extreme wide inner- and outer rings that are mostly equipt with mulitple row needle or roller and cage assemblies. The temperature limits of the radial needle bearing built-in units in the standard version in continuous operation are –40°C and +100°C, in short-term operation the upper limit is +120°C.

tech: KMF Needle Roller OD =  1.5, LENGTH = 7.8, RANGE OF USE SHAFT DIAMETER = 20. The bearings are sealed to help prevent contamination and retain lubrication. The needle rollers are high carbon chrome bearing steel through-hardened and ground. This Type Bearings CCNBH-S is designed for applications where holding close tolerances of the mounting holes may prove difficult. Available in slotted or hexed versions. The Neverlube bearings have a heat-treated steel roller with an SAE 841 oil impregnated bronze bushing rather than needle rollers. Continuous Self-Lubrication, Lower Cost, Clean Lubrication, Interchangeability. Neverlube bearings have an operating temperature range of -20 °F to +300 °F. All Neverlube bushings come standard with Chemlube 645 Synthetic lubricant. Applications of Neverlube Bearings are Food Processing Machinery, Farm and Construction Machinery, Machine Tools and Metalworking Machinery, Packaging Machinery.

desc: CNB-SBC -CHROME PLATED STANDARD HEXED SEALED CAM FOLLOWER
tech: (SBC Chrome Plated Cam Followers) bearings are manufactured from standard bearing steel and given a thin-dense chrome plating and stainless steel rollers. This provides much higher corrosion resistance than a standard cam follower at a reasonable cost. It also helps to improve the wear resistance of the bearings and maintain a higher load rating like a standard cam follower versus that of a 440C stainless bearing.

desc: CDR-S -HEAVY CYLINDRICAL ROLLER BEARINGS  CAM FOLLOWER
tech: CARTERS Heavy Cylindrical Roller Bearings (CDR Series) are interchangeable with standard needle CAM follower designs. Heavy Cylindrical Roller Bearings are capable of keeping the grease in until re-lube pressure is applied. The comparatively large diameter of the rollers provides substantially increased dynamic capacity and fatigue life. Heavy Cylindrical Roller Bearings have a VB type lip seals that offer a better seal than a standard needle bearing CAM follower, preventing debris from entering the interior of the bearing. These seals ride on smooth ground surfaces on the stud or inner ring. CARTER standard stock sizes of the CDR series starts at 1-1/2 inches outside diameter to 4-inch diameter.

desc: REALI-SLIM TT SERIES (NON-GEARED) FOUR-POINT CONTACT TURNTABLE BEARINGS
tech: These Bearings are most often designed to handle either radial or axial load conditions. But the Reali-Slim TT Series four-point contact bearings have a unique inner and outer race geometry that enables a single bearing to carry three types of loading (radial, axial and moment) simultaneously. Reali-Slim TT Series bearings may also be furnished with an internal diametral preload for those applications requiring greater stiffness or zero free play.

But the Reali-Slim TT Series four-point contact bearings have a unique inner and outer race geometry that enables a single bearing to carry three types of loading (radial, axial and moment) simultaneously. Reali-Slim TT Series bearings may also be furnished with an internal diametral preload for those applications requiring greater stiffness or zero free play.

desc: RULAND SHAFT COLLARS ONE PIECE SOLID (SET SCREW TYPE) METRIC
tech: Set screw collars are most effective when used on a shaft made of a material that is softer than the set screw. Ruland set screw collars are furnished exclusively with forged socket set screws for greater torque capacity and improved holding power. Forging of the stainless steel set screws has the additional benefit of work hardening, which results in stainless steel with elevated hardness and performance. Forged socket set screws, RoHS3 and REACH Compliant. Steel - Black Oxide : Cold drawn bar. Hot process black oxide, impregnated with napthenic oil, centrifugal dried.

This results in a tight fit and greater holding power, without the shaft damage caused by set screws. Ruland uses carefully selected materials and proprietary processes to ensure that the clamping gap remains open for simpler and more precise adjustment. Clamp style collars wrap around the shaft, providing high torsional holding power without the shaft damage and fretting that occurs when set screw style collars are used. The clamp style design does not mar the shaft, is easy to remove, and is indefinitely adjustable. It is commonly used for guiding, spacing, stopping, mounting, and component alignment. This double wide shaft collar has 25% higher axial holding power than a round bore of equivalent size. It can also be used as a short rigid coupling for applications where a traditional rigid coupling is too long. Single point faced, Balanced versions available, Additional sizes available. Stainless Steel (SS) Stainless Steel Grade 303 austenitic, non-magnetic bar with a bright finish.

Threaded collars provide axial holding power superior to smooth bore collars, while offering easier installation and adjustment than solid ring locking devices. Ruland double taps threads to ensure a precise and burr-free finish allowing for easy installation and removal, proper fit, and extended shaft life. The clamp style design will not mar the shaft. It is commonly used for guiding, spacing, stopping, mounting, and component alignment. Perpendicularity is critical for alignment when the shaft collar is used as a load bearing face, mechanical stop, or for mounting components such as gears or bearings. TCL is stamped with the Ruland name and bore size for ease of identification. Forged screws test beyond ANSI standards to ensure maximum holding power. Single point faced, Acme and Left-hand threads available. Stainless Steel (SS) Stainless Steel Grade 303 austenitic, non-magnetic bar with a bright finish.

desc: ROTARY TABLE BEARINGS WITH AXIAL-RADIAL BEARINGS
tech: ARTB bearings are axial/radial bearings. They comprise an angular contact ring, an outer ring and a cover washer as well as two cage-guided axial roller sets and a full complement radial roller set. This allows combined loads to be accommodated in the axial and radial directions and makes them a ready-to-install and easy-to-fit single-bearing solution. ARTB bearings from IBC are manufactured in a high-precision and an extended precision class and achieve running accuracies of a few micrometers.

Under the designation MMRBS and MBAS, the MMRB and MBA production series are also manufactured with an integrated labyrinth seal. The same cross section as for the MBA and MBC is used for the MMRB with radial securing system. The later permits larger loads and tightening torques. This is favorable in particular for preloading bearings supporting a high axial load. IBC Precisions Locknuts with fine thread are used for high-precision application. Due to integrated safety systems in the various locknuts, an easy and precise mounting, as well as safeguarding of locknuts is guaranteed.

Spherical Plain Bearings acccording to DIN ISO 12240-1 Dimesion Series K are two-piece plain bearings. They have no rolling elements, but consist of an inner and outer ring. The inner ring has a convex outer surface. The outer ring has a concave inner surface. This construction gives Spherical Plain Bearings their high load carrying capacity and capacity to accommodate misalignment. It has a steel on heavy duty bronze sliding contact. The steel inner ring contacts the bronze surface of the outer ring. The steel-on-bronze sliding contact makes this bearing highly wear-resistant, providing low friction. Regular Maintenance & Proper lubrication is required.

Outer ring: Steel lined with an antifriction film, consisting of PTFE, outer diameter ground.The outer ring has a concave inner surface. This construction gives Spherical Plain Bearings their high load carrying capacity and capacity to accommodate misalignment. Mating materials: Steel on PTFE, Maintenance free.

desc: MUCP 200 SERIES STAINLESS STEEL VERSION PILLOW BLOCK (SET-SCREW LOCKING)
tech: (Insert MUC 200) Pillow block bearings consist of a sealed single-row ball bearing with a spherical outer ring which is mounted in a housing. Because of the spherical outer surface of the bearing, shaft misalignment can be compensated for. The bearings are manufactured with a plus tolerance. This results in transition or press fits when using shafts with h-tolerances. The shaft is secured by grub screws on the inner ring. In normal applications, pillow block bearings are maintenance-free due to the lifetime lubrication. In difficult environmental conditions re-lubrication can be carried out over the grease nipple. Temperature range: -15 °C to +100 °C.

(THREAD = M6 x 18), The original Locking As­sem­blies featuring double-tapered thrust rings with self-releasing tapers. Features are : Easy installation, Low risk to contamination, Free from wear, Bending moment and radial loads. Applications : chain wheels, levers, pulleys, slip-on gear mechanisms, belt drums, running wheels, cable sheaves.

desc: SELF CENTRING LOCKING ASSEMBLY WITHOUT AXIAL DISPLACEMENT
tech: (THREAD = M6 x 20), These flange type units fix the hub positively against their extended flange preventing axial movement during tightening. Applied wherever self-centering action and good concentricity of mounted components are essential and hubs with straight-thru bores are used. Features are : High rotation speed, High radial loads, Axial hub positioning, High torque, Excellent concentricity and very easy to dismantle - these Locking As­sem­blies provide particularly good concentricity between the clamped parts. The flange is reinforced at the critical point, preventing bending or lifting of the inner ring during assembly and thereby ensuring easy dismantling.

Applied wherever self-centering action and good concentricity of mounted components are essential and hubs with straight-thru bores are used. Features are : High rotation speed, High radial loads, Axial hub positioning, High torque, Excellent concentricity and very easy to dismantle - these Locking As­sem­blies provide particularly good concentricity between the clamped parts. The flange is reinforced at the critical point, preventing bending or lifting of the inner ring during assembly and thereby ensuring easy dismantling.

desc: SELF CENTRING LOCKING ASSEMBLY WITHOUT AXIAL DISPLACEMENT
tech: (THREAD = M10 x 45), This locking device, dual tapered similar the 7012 type, is designed to transmit extremely high torques. Unlike the 7012 style, the 7014 device offers good centering ability due to it’s relatively long design, making a pre-centering hub section unnecessary. It’s design also provides for a different inside diameter to outside diameter ration, thereby not interchangeable with the other RINGFEDER types. Features are : Large transmittable peripheral forces – due to the long, flat cones it is possible to transmit maximum torques and axial forces with one RfN 7014 Locking Assembly. Maximum reliability – due to the flat cones and the relatively wide construction (large guide lengths) the Locking As­sem­blies RfN 7014 centre themselves. During installation the Locking Assembly, shaft and hub remain in position to one another. The shaft and hub are loaded by pressure, providing additional safety compared to 3-part versions. Applications : Heavy pulleys, Construction of heavy machinery, Coup­lings, Cable sheaves.

(THREAD = M6 x 20), These flange type units is made of stainless steel and fix the hub positively against their extended flange preventing axial movement during tightening. The flange is reinforced at the critical point, preventing bending or lifting of the inner ring during assembly and thereby ensuring easy dismantling. High rotation speed, High radial loads, Axial hub positioning, High torque – the increased number of clamping screws ensures the same transmission values as the RfN 7013.0.

(THREAD = M10), The RINGFEDER RfN 4051 is a three-part shrink disc and serves to transfer low to moderate torque. The narrow pressure rings require only a very small space. The transferrable torque can be set in a targeted manner for the corresponding application by changing the screw tightening torque. Lighter version for moderate transfer values – particularly suited for thin hubs and hollow shafts. Shrink discs are the modern method for creating a mechanical shrink fit. The shrink disc consists of either one or two thrust rings with tapered bores and a mating tapered inner ring. By tightening locking screws the thrust rings are drawn together compressing the inner ring and applying pressure to the outside of the hub clamping it to the shaft. Features are : Light design, Compensation of small tolerance errors, Maximum reliability, Slitted inner ring, Easy mounting, Low susceptibility to contamination.

Lighter version for moderate transfer values – particularly suited for thin hubs and hollow shafts. Shrink discs are the modern method for creating a mechanical shrink fit. The shrink disc consists of either one or two thrust rings with tapered bores and a mating tapered inner ring. By tightening locking screws the thrust rings are drawn together compressing the inner ring and applying pressure to the outside of the hub clamping it to the shaft. Features are : Light design, Compensation of small tolerance errors, Maximum reliability, Slitted inner ring, Easy mounting, Low susceptibility to contamination.

Cost-efficient solution with high capacity in the largest possible range of applications. The preload force can be set targeted to the relevant application. Features are : Unlimited range of applications, Standard series, Compensation of small tolerance errors, Maximum reliability, Slitted inner ring, Easy mounting, Low susceptibility to contamination.

desc: SHRINK DISCS (STANDARD SERIES FOR HIGH TORQUE)
tech: (THREAD = M16), Extension of the RINGFEDER RfN 4071 series cost-efficient solution with high capacity in the largest possible range of applications. The preload force can be set targeted to the relevant application. Slit inner ring – low losses and pressure on the hub. Shrink discs are the modern method for creating a mechanical shrink fit. The shrink disc consists of either one or two thrust rings with tapered bores and a mating tapered inner ring. By tightening locking screws the thrust rings are drawn together compressing the inner ring and applying pressure to the outside of the hub clamping it to the shaft. Features are : Unlimited range of applications, Standard series, Compensation of small tolerance errors, Maximum reliability, Slitted inner ring, Easy mounting, Easy removal, Low susceptibility to contamination.

GLYCODUR F sliding bearings have a steel base, to which a 0.2 to 0.4 mm porous tin bronze layer is sintered. The pores of this layer are filled during a rolling process with polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) and other friction and wear reducing additives. GLYCODUR F sliding bearings combine in optimal manner the mechanical properties of the sintered bronze with the sliding and lubrication properties of a PTFE mixture. The structure of this composite material results in good dimensional stability and good thermal conductivity. GLYCODUR F bearings cover a much larger temperature range between -200 to +260 °C (-328 to +500 °F). This large range results from the special material combination used for the sliding layer with its excellent heat conductivity.

desc: CROSS CYLINDRICAL ROLLER SLEWING BEARINGS WITH INTERNAL GEAR
tech: Cross cylindrical roller slewing bearings can accommodate axial loads, tilting moments, and radial loads simultaneously. Unlike ball slewing bearings, these bearings use rollers instead of balls, resulting in line contact rather than point contact. Features are : Increased load capacity due to line contact, Composed of an inner ring, outer ring, a single row of rollers, cage, and seal, Full complement roller designs can handle heavy loads but may lead to greater friction and wear. Applications : Typically used in heavy-duty construction machinery and equipment requiring high load support and precision.

desc: LIGHT VERSION UNGEARED SLEWING RING (STANDARD HOLE)
tech: TECMA DRIVES light series of slewing rings comply with international standards, requirements and are approved for different simple and complex applications. Slewing rings are composed of two rings, one inner and one outer, in which raceway are obtained that contain rolling elements on which the working loads are transmitted from the moving ring to the fixed one. The operating temperature of our slewing rings ranges from -25ºC to + 60ºC. TECMA DRIVE slewing rings are pre-lubricated with a lithium-complex grease based on mineral oil with EP-additive. SD = Without gear teeth, C = Light standard version.

Slewing rings are composed of two rings, one inner and one outer, in which raceway are obtained that contain rolling elements on which the working loads are transmitted from the moving ring to the fixed one. They should be transported and stored horizontally or on specially adapted incline frames. The operating temperature of our slewing rings ranges from -25ºC to + 60ºC. TECMA DRIVE slewing rings are pre-lubricated with a lithium-complex grease based on mineral oil with EP-additive. SD = Without gear teeth, C = Light standard version.

desc: LR SERIES DOUBLE ROW TRACK ROLLER BEARINGS
tech: The bearing is a ball-bearing Yoke type track roller, of which the rolling elements combine low friction with high precision. Track rollers are designed for use with various types of tracks. Thanks to a thick-walled outer ring, they can withstand high radial loads. Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. Yoke type track rollers are suitable for mounting on a shaft. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support. This bearing is equipped with a cage that prevents the rolling elements from coming into contact with each other. This design allows for a controlled movement of the rolling elements. There is lower friction compared to full complement track rollers, allowing for higher rotational speeds and less heat generation. Common applications of support rollers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam mechanisms. 2HRS - Lip Seals On Both Sides Made From Nitrile Butadiene Rubber, TVH - Moulded Polyamide Cage Snap-Type, Rolling Element Riding, XL - X-Life.

The FM-100 is a cam follower model manufactured by Smith Bearing. It is a type of needle roller bearing designed for cam and track roller applications. These followers are used to convert rotary motion from a cam into linear motion in a variety of mechanisms. Smith Bearing is known for producing high-precision needle roller bearings for both industrial and aerospace applications. (THREAD 5/16-24)

Cam followers like the FM-100 are used in a wide range of machinery and equipment, including:


	Automotive engines (as hydraulic tappets). 
	Material handling equipment. 
	Automation systems. 
	Various other industrial applications.

LR Series Yoke type track roller, of which the rolling elements combine low friction with high precision. Track rollers are designed for use with various types of tracks. Thanks to a thick-walled outer ring, they can withstand high radial loads. Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. Yoke type track rollers are suitable for mounting on a shaft. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support.This design allows for a controlled movement of the rolling elements. There is lower friction compared to full complement track rollers, allowing for higher rotational speeds and less heat generation. NPP - Ball Bearing, With Low-Friction Seal At Both Sides. Seal Consists Of Sheet Steel Washer With Vulcanized Rubber, U - Crowned Outside Surface.

Temperatur range -60°C to +200°C. Axial Spherical Plain Bearings are designed to accommodate axial and radial loads while providing smooth rotational movement. These bearings are particularly useful in applications where there is a need for high load-carrying capacity and angular misalignment. The spherical design allows for some degree of misalignment between the shaft and housing, making them ideal for machinery that experiences dynamic loads or movement. The spherical plain bearings are typically used in heavy machinery, construction equipment, and various industrial applications where high load and durability are essential. They are available in different sizes and configurations, ensuring they can meet the requirements of various industrial needs. AX: Sliding Contact Surface Steel/Steel.

desc: RAIDAL SPHERICAL PLAIN BEARINGS REQUIRING MAINTENANCE
tech: Raidal spherical plain bearing. Spherical plain bearings are two-piece plain bearings. They have no rolling elements, but consist of an inner and outer ring. The inner ring has a convex outer surface. The outer ring has a concave inner surface. This construction gives spherical plain bearings their high load carrying capacity and capacity to accommodate misalignment. Steel-on-PTFE sliding contact which makes it maintenance-free. PTFE is a special plastic. During the run-in period of these plain bearings, particles of PTFE are deposited on the opposite running surface. They fill in the small irregularities of the inner ring surface, creating a smooth surface. C : Steel/PTFE Sintered Bronze Sliding Contact Surface

Needle rollers can be used to design full complement bearing arrangements for low-speed or oscillating applications. These compact bearing arrangements have a very high load carrying capacity when compared to bearings with a cage and are economical, provided the shaft and housing bore can serve as raceways raceways on shafts and in housings. They are made of carbon chromium steel, have a hardness of 58 to 65 HRC and have a precision ground surface. Main dimensions according to DIN 620. Features are : They are made of hardened rolling bearing steel, They have a precision machined raceway, The chamfers at the front sides make possible an easy insertion into the bearing and prevent damages at the seal lip.

They are made of carbon chromium steel, have a hardness of 58 to 65 HRC and have a precision ground surface. Main dimensions according to DIN 620. Features are : They are made of hardened rolling bearing steel, They have a precision machined raceway, The chamfers at the front sides make possible an easy insertion into the bearing and prevent damages at the seal lip.

They utilize needle rollers in a full complement configuration (no cage) to maximize load capacity, are designed for shaft mounting, and are supplied fully lubricated with a high quality multipurpose grease but are also re-lubricatable through a radial oil hole found in the inner race. Yoke Rollers are commonly used in industrial applications such as: material handling equipment, ram support rollers, and indexing equipment. Seals (suffix S) utilizing internal thrust washers extend service life in dusty environments or in conditions of infrequent re-lubrication.

Track Roller or support roller with cylindrical rollers. These rolling elements combine a high load capacity with reasonable shock resistance. Track rollers are designed for use with various types of tracks. Thanks to a thick-walled outer ring, they can withstand high radial loads. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support.

desc: CF SERIES STUD TYPE TRACK ROLLERS
tech: 10-32 : Cam follower with needle rollers. These rolling elements combine high load capacity with a compact design. Cam followers are designed for use with various types of tracks. Thanks to a thick-walled outer ring, they can withstand high radial loads. Instead of an inner ring, they feature a solid, threaded stud, enabling easy mounting. Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support. The absence of a cage allows for a greater number of rolling elements, making this cam follower radially highly loadable. Full complement cam followers are also more shock-resistant than cam followers with a cage. Common applications of cam followers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam mechanisms. N : Narrow Roller Width.

Thanks to a thick-walled outer ring, they can withstand high radial loads. Instead of an inner ring, they feature a solid, threaded stud, enabling easy mounting. Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support. The absence of a cage allows for a greater number of rolling elements, making this cam follower radially highly loadable. Full complement cam followers are also more shock-resistant than cam followers with a cage. Common applications of cam followers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam mechanisms. S : Cam Follower, Camrol, Sealed Version.

desc: CCFE-SB SERIES STUD TYPE TRACK ROLLERS
tech: 1/2-20 : This bearings are full complement needle bearings feature black oxide treated bearing steel, available in two basic mounting styles for use in mechanical automation or linear motion applications. CCFE= With Eccentric Stud, S = Cam Follwer With Seal On Both Side, Crowned O.D, B = Hex Socket. Hexagonal hole is provided in the stud face on selected sizes for use with applications involving bearings mounted in blind holes or with self-locking nuts requiring greater than average thread torque. A screw-driver slot is provided at the flanged end of the stud for the purpose of preventing the stud from turning when the nut is tightened. A crown on the OD of a cam follower bearing can increase bearing life versus a standard cylindrical cam follower. The eccentric stud feature provides a means of easy radial adjustment for precise positioning of cam followers, track, guide and support rollers. CCFE Series offer Crowned O.D & Eccentric Stud Sealed and Unsealed bearings. Cam followers with LUBRI-DISC seals.

Needle roller and cage assemblies are self-contained, ready-to-mount bearings without inner and outer rings. In applications where the shaft and housing bore can serve as raceways, the assemblies can be used to create bearing arrangements that require minimal radial space. As the clearance of the bearing arrangement is only affected by the roller sorting and the finish of shaft and housing, very precise bearing arrangements can be achieved. Features are : High radial load carrying capacity, High stiffness, High precision, Lowest cross-sectional height among rolling bearings, Accommodate axial displacement in both directions.

As the clearance of the bearing arrangement is only affected by the roller sorting and the finish of shaft and housing, very precise bearing arrangements can be achieved. Features are : High radial load carrying capacity, High stiffness, High precision, Lowest cross-sectional height among rolling bearings, Accommodate axial displacement in both directions.

This series is a standard combined roller bearing manufactured by the WD Bearing. This bearing is designed for use in material handling equipment like forklifts and stackers. This series features a 2RS designation, meaning it has two rubber seals. These seals are molded to a steel insert and fixed into a groove in the outer ring. this type of seal provides excellent protection from environmental contaminants as it makes contact with the inner ring. Features are : Compact structure, Supports high dynamic and static loads, including impact loads,Versatility, Good sealing performance for reliable and longer life, High-quality grease for maximum life, Some variants can be used in corrosive environments or high temperatures. Applications : Port equipment, Steel industry, Aluminum industry, Automobile industry applications, General machinery building and automation projects, Packaging, wood, and paper industries.

This bearings is a standard combined roller bearing manufactured by the brand WD. It\'s designed to handle both radial and thrust loads, offering a space-saving solution compared to using separate bearings. Combined Roller Bearing (designed to manage both radial and axial loads). Material: Typically chrome steel or bearing steel (GcR15).  Features are : Compact structure and simple installation, High radial and axial loads, Impact and shock resistance, Long lifespan, Versatility. Applications : Truck lift columns, Conveying systems, Horizontal, vertical, cantilevered, or telescopic linear motion applications, Forklift trucks, Stackers, Port equipment. ZRS : combined roller bearing with a metal shield on one side and a rubber seal on the other. This combined sealing system offers a balanced approach to protection and performance for these bearings in various industrial environments. Operating Temperature Range: -12℃ to 88℃.

The internal gear on the inner ring allows it to be driven by a pinion gear. Applications : This type of bearing is used in machinery that requires large-scale rotation under heavy load conditions, including : Cranes, Excavators, Hoisting and mechanical handling equipment, General industrial machinery.

The internal gear on the inner ring allows it to be driven by a pinion gear. Applications : This type of bearing is used in machinery that requires large-scale rotation under heavy load conditions, including : Cranes, Excavators, Hoisting and mechanical handling equipment, General industrial machinery.

This bearing type is designed to handle combined axial, radial, and tilting moment loads. Materials: The rings are commonly made from high-strength steels like 50Mn or 42CrMo, and the balls from chrome steel (52100). Features are : Combined load capacity, External gear teeth, Compact and lightweight, Low maintenance, Long service life, Cost-effective, Low-speed, high-torque operation. Applications : Construction equipment, Industrial machinery, Metallurgical and mining equipment, Marine equipment, Tunnel boring machines, Road rollers and graders, Wind blade transporters, Offshore equipment.

Four-point contact ball slewing bearing with internal gearing. It is  Designed to handle high axial, radial, and tilting moment loads simultaneously. This heavy-duty bearing is designed for machinery that requires robust, large-scale rotation under complex load conditions. Material : Typically constructed from high-strength steels like 42CrMo or 50Mn for the rings and 52100 chrome steel for the balls. A four-point contact ball slewing ring has a compact structure with a single row of balls that contact the raceways at four points. This allows it to absorb forces from multiple directions simultaneously. The bearing consists of an inner ring, an outer ring, a set of balls, and a cage or separators to hold the balls in place. The internal gear on the inner ring allows it to be driven by a pinion gear. Applications : This type of bearing is used in machinery that requires large-scale rotation under heavy load conditions, including : Cranes, Excavators, Hoisting and mechanical handling equipment, General industrial machinery.

Material : Typically constructed from high-strength steels like 42CrMo or 50Mn for the rings and 52100 chrome steel for the balls. A four-point contact ball slewing ring has a compact structure with a single row of balls that contact the raceways at four points. This allows it to absorb forces from multiple directions simultaneously. The bearing consists of an inner ring, an outer ring, a set of balls, and a cage or separators to hold the balls in place. The internal gear on the inner ring allows it to be driven by a pinion gear. Applications : This type of bearing is used in machinery that requires large-scale rotation under heavy load conditions, including : Cranes, Excavators, Hoisting and mechanical handling equipment, General industrial machinery.

desc: CFH - Heavy Stud Cam Follower With Inch Dimensions
tech:
CFH - Heavy Stud Cam Follower With Inch Dimensions , S - Sealed Version , Screw Driver slot

The CFH5S is a cam follower with needle rollers. These rolling elements combine high load capacity with a compact design. Cam followers are designed for use with various types of tracks. Thanks to a thick-walled outer ring, they can withstand high radial loads. Instead of an inner ring, they feature a solid, threaded stud, enabling easy mounting. Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support.

The HTAR is a cage-guided needle roller bearing manufactured by the German company Harhues & Teufert. It is a specific model within the HTAR series, which is known for its high precision and load capacity in a compact design. The needle rollers are held in place by a cage, which allows for higher speeds and smoother operation compared to full-complement versions by reducing friction. Features are : High Load Capacity, Robust Construction, High limiting speed. Applications : Mechanical engineering, Automation technology, Industrial machinery, Machine tools, Material handling systems.

The HTAV series is a full needle-caged support roller with similar dimensions but a higher load capacity due to the greater number of needles. The HTAR 5 is a cage-guided support roller, a type of linear technology bearing manufactured by Harhues & Teufert GmbH. It is used to support and guide moving parts within various industrial applications. The roller features an outer ring, an inner ring, a cage to space and guide the needle rollers, and flanged rings. Features are : High-speed capability, Medium load capacity, Precision and rigidity, Maintenance-free. Applications : Support radial and axial loads, Provide precise and low-friction guidance for moving components, Accommodate high speeds, Conveyor systems, Material handling equipment, Automation systems.

Series 131 internal clamping element designed for shaft-hub connections. This locking assembly secures a hub onto a shaft without keyways. When the screws are tightened, the two conical rings are drawn together. Series 131 clamping elements are self-centering, ensuring concentric alignment between the shaft and hub. Features are : Keyless, high-friction connection, Even stress distribution, Ready-to-install, Simple assembly and disassembly, Self-centering, High-grade materials, No axial displacement, High torque transmission, Pre-lubricated for easy installation. Applications : Power transmission, Pulleys and conveyor belts, CNC machines, Material handling, Packaging machines, Printing presses, Robotics, Conveyor systems.

THREAD = M8 x1.25. The SMG series is a rod end. Rod ends consist of a housing with integral shank and a spherical plain bearing. This plain bearing is composed of an inner and outer ring without rolling elements. Rod ends are often mounted on the end of hydraulic or pneumatic cylinders. They are also used to connect two shafts. Rod ends can accommodate misalignment, and they support radial forces in a tensile or compressive direction. This bearing has a spherical plain bearing with a steel-on-bronze sliding contact. The steel inner ring contacts the bronze surface of the outer ring. The steel-on-bronze sliding contact makes this bearing highly wear-resistant, providing low friction. However, the load capacity is slightly lower compared to spherical plain bearings with steel-on-steel sliding contacts. This bearing needs regular maintenance. Proper lubrication is required to reduce friction and prevent fouling and corrosion.

They are also used to connect two shafts. Rod ends can accommodate misalignment, and they support radial forces in a tensile or compressive direction. This bearinng has a spherical plain bearing with a steel-on-PTFE sliding contact, making it maintenance-free. PTFE is a special plastic. During the run-in period of these plain bearings, particles of PTFE are deposited on the opposite running surface. They fill in the small irregularities of the inner ring surface, creating a smooth surface. As a result, the components fit each other perfectly.

This bearing type requires regular maintenance. Proper lubrication is required to reduce friction and prevent fouling and corrosion.

desc: STANDARD SSA SERIES ROD END BEARINGS
tech: The UNIBAL SSA series is a spherical plain bearing from the competition series, featuring a steel-on-steel sliding contact for high wear resistance and load-carrying capacity. It is designed for applications involving oscillating, rotating, and tilting movements. The bearing requires regular maintenance and lubrication to prevent friction and corrosion. Materials : The bearing has a steel-on-steel construction, meaning both the inner and outer rings are made of steel. The bush is made of steel and is zinc chromated blue, it is made of C35Pb (1.0502) steel. Features are : High static load capacity, High wear resistance, Durability and resilience, Accommodates misalignment, Supports complex movements, Excellent impact resistance, Maintenance requirements, Compact design. Applications : Oscillating machinery, Mechanical control systems, Agricultural equipment, Industrial gearboxes, Material handling, Pumps and compressors.

desc: STANDARD SSE SERIES ROD END BEARINGS
tech: The SSE series belongs to UNIBAL’s Standard series standard spherical plain bearing. The bearing features a Uniflon E sliding surface, based on a PTFE composite fabric, that is self-lubricating. No additional greasing or maintenance is required. In fact, adding lubricant will impair the self-lubricating effect and reduce the bearing\\\'s life. They are two-piece plain bearings (inner ring + outer ring), without rolling elements. The inner ring has a convex outer surface, the outer ring has a concave inner surface. That design gives capability for angular misalignment. The series is designed for “high stress, maintenance free applications” under general mechanics. Features are : Self-lubricating sliding surface, Reduced wear and friction, Improper lubrication, Corrosion resistance, High load capacity, Shock and vibration resistance. Applications : Construction and heavy machinery, Industrial automation and robotics, Aerospace and defense, Railway and other transport systems, Marine and offshore applications, Material handling equipment.

The series is designed for “high stress, maintenance free applications” under general mechanics. Features are : Self-lubricating sliding surface, Reduced wear and friction, Improper lubrication, Corrosion resistance, High load capacity, Shock and vibration resistance. Applications : Construction and heavy machinery, Industrial automation and robotics, Aerospace and defense, Railway and other transport systems, Marine and offshore applications, Material handling equipment.

desc: COMPETITION SSE SERIES ROD END BEARINGS
tech: The Unibal SSE..50 series is a maintenance-free spherical plain bearing from the Competition Series. It consists of an inner ring with a convex outer surface and an outer ring with a concave inner surface. This design allows for high load-carrying capacity and accommodates misalignment. The SSE series bearings are designed to be self-lubricating, requiring no upkeep during operation. This is different from the standard SS series, which requires regular lubrication. Material : It features a steel-on-PTFE sliding contact. During the run-in period, PTFE particles are transferred to the inner ring, creating a low-friction, self-lubricating surface. Features are : Maintenance-free operation, High static load capacity, Impact and wear resistance, Accommodation of misalignment, Precision engineering. Applications : Construction and mining, Industrial gearboxes, Conveyor system, Aerospace and defense, Robotics and automation.

McGill CAMROL bearings are full complement needle bearings feature black oxide treated bearing steel, available in two basic mounting styles for use in mechanical automation or linear motion applications. Full-type roller bearing CF bearing the ultimate in radial capacity, improving its load-carrying qualities to complement its resistance to shock. A soft stud stem adds toughness and permits reworking for slight dimensional changes. Holes through either side or ends of the stud provide for convenient relubrication. CF Series offer Standard Sealed and Unsealed bearings. CF - Cam Follower, Screw Driver Slot. A screw-driver slot is provided at the flanged end of the stud for the purpose of preventing the stud from turning when the nut is tightened. screw-driver slot is rounded and in some cases it may be necessary to use a special screw-driver having a rounded edge to hold the stud securely.

desc: CFE - CAM FOLLOWERS WITH ECCENTRIC STUDS (LUBRI-DISC SEALS)
tech: McGill CAMROL bearings are full complement needle bearings feature black oxide treated bearing steel, available in two basic mounting styles for use in mechanical automation or linear motion applications. CFE - Cam Follower With Eccentric Stud, S - Sealed Version, Screw Driver Slot. A screw-driver slot is provided at the flanged end of the stud for the purpose of preventing the stud from turning when the nut is tightened. Screw-driver slot is rounded and in some cases it may be necessary to use a special screw-driver having a rounded edge to hold the stud securely. The eccentric stud feature provides a means of easy radial adjustment for precise positioning of cam followers, track, guide and support rollers. Eccentric stud CAMROL bearings can be aligned without the need for close tolerances of mounting holes and members. CFE Series offer Eccentric Studs Sealed and Unsealed bearings. Cam followers with LUBRI-DISC seals.

desc: CFH-S SERIES HEAVY STUD CAM FOLLOWERS WITH LUBRI-DISC SEALS
tech: McGill CAMROL bearings are full complement needle bearings feature black oxide treated bearing steel, available in two basic mounting styles for use in mechanical automation or linear motion applications. CFH - Heavy Stud Cam Follower With, S - Sealed Version. Suffix “S” indicates a sealed version with LUBRI-DISC® seals (on both sides) to retain lubricant and keep out contaminants. The “heavy stud” designation implies the stud is more robust (larger diameter, stronger design) to better resist bending, deflection, shock, or heavier loads compared to standard studs. Reduced maintenance frequency compared to unsealed versions (but not maintenance-free). Extended life in dirty or harsh environments due to seal protection.

desc: CFH-B SERIES HEAVY STUD CAM FOLLOWERS WITH HEX HOLE (UNSEALED)
tech: McGill CAMROL bearings are full complement needle bearings feature black oxide treated bearing steel, available in two basic mounting styles for use in mechanical automation or linear motion applications. CFH - Heavy Stud Cam Follower, B - Hex Socket. Hexagonal hole is provided in the stud face on selected sizes for use with applications involving bearings mounted in blind holes or with self-locking nuts requiring greater than average thread torque. CFH-B cam followers are used in heavy duty cam, track, or linear guide systems where loads / shock demands are large and protection (seals) may be managed externally. Typical uses include machinery, automation, indexing systems, pressing machines, conveyors under heavy load, etc. Unsealed / Open (non-sealed) design — i.e. no LUBRI-DISC seals (or other sealing elements).

The built-in lubrication groove and oil hole facilitate greasing even in open designs. Suitable for applications where covers, shields or external protection can be provided.

desc: CYR-S SERIES YOKE CAM FOLLOWERS WITH LUBRI-DISC SEALS
tech: CYR stands for yoke (shaft-mounted) cam followers / rollers. The “S” suffix indicates sealed versions - i.e. these have built-in LUBRI-DISC seals on both sides to retain lubricant and help exclude contamination. These are yoke-type rollers, meaning they mount on a shaft or journal (not via a stud). Roller elements and raceways: chrome bearing steel. External surfaces: black oxide or similar corrosion-resistant finish. Seals help maintain lubricant life and protect internal roller/race elements from external contaminants. Because grease retention is better and contamination ingress reduced, life under harsher conditions is improved. Sealed versions require less frequent relubrication compared to open counterparts. Heavy cross-sectioned outer race helps resist shock loads common in cam / track follower applications.

desc: CCYR-S SERIES YOKE CAM FOLLOWERS WITH LUBRI-DISC SEALS
tech: C = Crowned (outer roller surface is slightly convex / crowned). CYR = Yoke-type (shaft / journal mounted) cam follower / roller. S = Sealed version — includes LUBRI-DISC seals on both ends to retain lubricant and reduce contaminant ingress. The roller’s O.D. is slightly convex (crowned) to help distribute load, reduce edge stresses, and tolerate slight misalignment. Sealed version helps protect internal rollers / raceways from contaminants, improving life in dusty or dirty environments. Yoke mounting provides support from both ends (shaft supports) which reduces bending / deflection risks compared to single-ended support. Heavy outer race and robust design suit heavy shock or intermittent loading conditions.

desc: CAM FOLLOWERS WITH LUBRI-DISC SEALS & NON-METALLIC BUSHINGS
tech: BCF-S SERIES BUSHING TYPE is a non-metallic bushing replaces rollers and provides load support and a sliding motion that eliminates or reduces need for bearing lubrication. BCF stands for Bushing Cam Follower—i.e. instead of needle rollers, this type uses a non-metallic bearing bushing internally. The suffix S indicates that it is a sealed version, using LUBRI-DISC® seals on the ends to retain lubricant and prevent contamination. These are stud-mount cam followers, meaning they mount via a stud (threaded stem) into a housing or fixture (rather than yoke / shaft mounting). Low Maintenance / Maintenance-Free, Reduced Noise / Friction, Cleaner Operation, Simplicity & Reliability, Shock Capability.

BCF stands for Bushing Cam Follower—i.e. instead of needle rollers, this type uses a non-metallic bearing bushing internally. The suffix S indicates that it is a sealed version, using LUBRI-DISC® seals on the ends to retain lubricant and prevent contamination. These are stud-mount cam followers, meaning they mount via a stud (threaded stem) into a housing or fixture (rather than yoke / shaft mounting). Low Maintenance / Maintenance-Free, Reduced Noise / Friction, Cleaner Operation, Simplicity & Reliability, Shock Capability.

desc: CAM FOLLOWERS WITH HEX HOLE, LUBRI-DISC SEALS & NON-METALLIC BUSHINGS
tech: BCF-SB indicates a bushing-type, sealed, stud-mount cam follower. The non-metallic bushing replaces needle rollers, enabling lower maintenance or “self-lubricating” behavior in some applications. B = Bushing (non-metallic bushing type cam follower). CF = Cam Follower (stud-mount, cylindrical rolling / sliding element outer surface). SB = Sealed (LUBRI-DISC seal + Hex Head). Cleaner Operation: Sealed design and no external grease leakage make it good in environments where you want minimal contamination or leakage. With a heavy outer race and robust construction, these followers can handle shock loads better than simpler variants. Fewer moving parts (no rollers or cage) simplifies design and potentially reduces failure modes in some conditions.

desc: CAM FOLLOWERS WITH LUBRI-DISC SEALS & NON-METALLIC BUSHINGS
tech: B = Bushing (i.e. non-metallic internal element instead of needle rollers), CCF = Crowned Cam Follower (i.e. the outer roller surface is crowned / curved to reduce edge loading). S = Sealed (“S”) via LUBRI-DISC® seals on both sides. With sealed construction and bushing interior, these require less frequent lubrication vs open roller followers. The non-metallic bushing and the seals help resist dirt / dust ingress better than bare rollers in many environments. The crowned outer surface helps mitigate edge loading due to small misalignments. Sliding contact in a good bushing often produces quieter operation (depending on load / speed) compared to roller contact.

In this series a non-metallic bushing replaces rollers and provides load support and a sliding motion that eliminates or reduces need for bearing lubrication. \" Y\" stands for Yoke Type Design: Provides robust support for heavy radial loads and misalignment. Sealed (S) Version: Non-metallic seals prevent contamination and retain lubrication. These yoke rollers are suitable for motion systems, conveyor guidance, cam follower systems, linear tracks, or other machinery where a roller must follow a surface while constrained in a yoke. The crowned OD and needle roller design help in mildly misaligned conditions or bending moments. External surfaces often have a black oxide finish for corrosion resistance.

desc: MCF SERIES METRIC CAMROL FULL COMPLEMENT (UNSEALED) BEARING
tech: MCF Series is the Metric CAMROL stud-type cam follower series. These are stud type cam followers (i.e. with a threaded stud). They are designed to carry radial loads and in some designs also limited thrust or combined loads, in a mechanical cam / track / follower application. The use of needle rollers (full complement) allows more load bearing in limited cross-section. The crowned outer surface helps reduce edge loading and cope with slight misalignment or track errors, thereby improving life. Robust stud design, Ease of maintenance, Corrosion resistance.

desc: MCF-S METRIC CAMROL FULL COMPLEMENT (SEALED) BEARING
tech: The MCF-S series from McGill represents a family of sealed stud-type cam followers within the CAMROL line. These bearings are designed to provide anti-friction support for linear movement or to follow the surface of a cam, offering a broad range of designs to suit various applications. The \"S\" designation indicates that these cam followers come with a LUBRI-DISC® seal, which helps retain lubrication and exclude contaminants, enhancing bearing life and performance. The outer race is slightly convex, allowing for better alignment and load distribution, which is particularly beneficial in applications with slight misalignment. High radial load capacity in a compact form factor. The MCF-S series features a stud-type mounting, facilitating easy installation and adjustment in various applications.

desc: MCFR-S METRIC CAMROL CAGE TYPE (SEALED) BEARING
tech: The MCFR-S series from McGill (now part of Regal Rexnord) represents a line of sealed, stud-type cam followers within the CAMROL family. These bearings are designed to provide anti-friction support for linear movement or to follow the surface of a cam, offering a broad range of designs to suit various applications. The \"S\" designation indicates that these cam followers come with a LUBRI-DISC seal, which helps retain lubrication and exclude contaminants, enhancing bearing life and performance. The outer race is slightly convex, allowing for better alignment and load distribution, which is particularly beneficial in applications with slight misalignment. The MCFR-S series features a stud-type mounting, facilitating easy installation and adjustment in various applications. High radial load capacity in a compact form factor.

desc: MCF-B METRIC CAMROL FULL COMPLEMENT (UNSEALED) BEARING
tech: The McGill MCF-B Series is a metric stud-type cam follower from the CAMROL series, designed for applications requiring high radial load capacity and precise linear motion. B = Basic or standard full complement cylindrical roller cam follower, unsealed, stud-type. The MCF 16 B cam follower is ideal for applications requiring: High radial load capacity in a compact form factor, Unsealed bearings where external sealing is not critical. Crowned outer diameter to accommodate slight misalignments. Common uses include: Automated machinery, Conveyor systems, Packaging equipment, Textile machinery, Material handling systems.

desc: MCF-X METRIC CAMROL FULL COMPLEMENT (UNSEALED) BEARING
tech: The McGill MCF-X Straight Cylindrical Outside Roller Diameter Cam follower is a metric stud-type cam follower from the CAMROL series, designed for applications requiring high radial load capacity and precise linear motion. X = Cylindrical cam follower with flat rollers, unsealed. It Provides a large contact area, ideal for applications with flat cam profiles or where minimal misalignment is expected. Retained Needle Rollers: Maximizes radial load capacity in a compact design. Hex Hole Stud: Allows for secure mounting and easy installation. Open Design: Suitable for applications where external sealing is not critical. Jam Nuts and Lubrication Fitting: Included to facilitate maintenance and ensure proper lubrication. Common uses include: Automated machinery, Conveyor systems, Packaging equipment, Textile machinery etc.

desc: MCF-BX METRIC CAMROL FULL COMPLEMENT (UNSEALED) BEARING

desc: PCF SERIES TRAKROL CAM FOLLOWER BEARINGS
tech: PCF Series (TRAKROL) cam follower bearings are heavy-duty, stud-type track rollers with plain cylindrical outer surfaces, designed for combined radial + thrust loads, shock loading, track or cam type applications. They feature black oxide finish bearing steel, sealed design (in many sizes), heavy section outer race and quality insert (ball or tapered roller) depending on size. Typical uses include machine tool tracks, heavy automation equipment, conveyors, indexing machines, cam drives and other systems requiring a follower that can roll along a track or face under moderate to heavy load.

The McGill MI series inner races is a hardened and precision-ground steel ring designed to serve as the inner raceway for needle roller bearings, specifically in applications where the shaft cannot be heat-treated to the necessary hardness or finish. Materials : High-quality 52100 bearing quality chrome steel. This is an optimal solution when the shaft material or design prevents direct hardening and grinding of the shaft surface itself.  The MI series inner rings are designed to be fully compatible with McGill\'s Cagerol and Guiderol needle bearings, providing flexibility in application design. Features are : Corrosion Inhibition, Separable Design, Precision Tolerances. Applications : Automotive and Transportation Systems, Pumps and Compressors, Printing Machinery, Machine Tools, Conveyor Systems, Agricultural Equipment.

desc: SINGLE ROW SPHERICAL ROLLER WITH TAPERED BORE
tech: The McGill SB..KW33SS series is a single-row, sealed spherical roller bearing with a tapered bore. This design, part of the SPHERE-ROL series, is built for high loads and exceptional tolerance to misalignment in demanding industrial applications. Designed to handle radial loads and moderate axial loads (in both directions) while accommodating shaft misalignment and shaft deflection. It is manufactured with a cylindrical bore and designed to handle high radial loads and moderate axial loads while accommodating significant shaft misalignment. Material : Constructed from high-quality 52100 bearing steel for both the inner and outer rings and rolling elements. The bearing is designed with a single, concave outer raceway that allows the inner ring assembly to swivel or misalign relative to the outer ring. This accommodates significant shaft misalignment and deflections without introducing excessive stress, friction, or heat. Features are : High Load Capacity, Reduced Friction with Misalignment, Effective Contamination Exclusion, Reduced Heat Generation, Reduced cost, Longevity and Long Service Life. Applications : Conveyors and processing equipment, Mining and earthmoving machinery, Industrial fans and blowers, Agricultural machinery. W33=Lubrication Groove And Three Holes In Bearing Outer Ring, YS=LAMBDA-Seals one side.

desc: INNER RING FOR NEEDLE ROLLER BEARING
tech: The Nadella BIC bearing is a specific needle roller bearing inner ring. It is not a complete bearing on its own but is designed to be used with a needle roller and cage assembly, serving as the inner raceway for the needle rollers when the shaft itself cannot be used for that purpose. The bearing is manufactured from high-quality chrome steel by Nadella. The BIC series is typically mounted with a tight interference fit in the housing bore. This enables a simple and economical design, as shoulders or snap rings are not required for axial location. Material : High-quality chrome steel (SAE 52100 equivalent). Features are : High Load Capacity, Compact Design, Durability and Precision, Axial Displacement, Ease of Assembly. Applications : Automotive transmissions and gearboxes, Pumps and compressors, Industrial presses and conveyors, Heavy-duty industrial setups, Packaging Machinery, Medical Equipment.

The Nadella GC series is a cam follower with needle rollers. These rolling elements combine high load capacity with a compact design. Cam followers are designed for use with various types of tracks. Thanks to a thick-walled outer ring, they can withstand high radial loads. Instead of an inner ring, they feature a solid, threaded stud, enabling easy mounting. Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support. This bearing has a full complement design. The absence of a cage allows for a greater number of rolling elements, making this cam follower radially highly loadable. Full complement cam followers are also more shock-resistant than cam followers with a cage. However, the maximum rotational speed is lower than that of caged variants. Common applications of cam followers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam mechanisms.

Instead of an inner ring, they feature a solid, threaded stud, enabling easy mounting. Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support. This bearing has a full complement design. The absence of a cage allows for a greater number of rolling elements, making this cam follower radially highly loadable. Full complement cam followers are also more shock-resistant than cam followers with a cage. However, the maximum rotational speed is lower than that of caged variants. Common applications of cam followers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam mechanisms. SW : Cam Followers Without Stud With Optimized Profile.

Instead of an inner ring, they feature a solid, threaded stud, enabling easy mounting. Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support. This bearings has a full complement design. The absence of a cage allows for a greater number of rolling elements, making this cam follower radially highly loadable. Full complement cam followers are also more shock-resistant than cam followers with a cage. However, the maximum rotational speed is lower than that of caged variants. Common applications of cam followers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam mechanisms. SW : Cam Followers Without Stud With Optimized Profile.

Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. Yoke type track rollers are suitable for mounting on a shaft. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support. This design allows for a controlled movement of the rolling elements. There is lower friction compared to full complement track rollers, allowing for higher rotational speeds and less heat generation. Common applications of support rollers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam mechanisms. MM : Metal Shields.

The FG series is a track roller or support roller with needle rollers. These rolling elements combine high load capacity with a compact design. Track rollers are designed for use with various types of tracks. Thanks to a thick-walled outer ring, they can withstand high radial loads. Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. Yoke type track rollers are suitable for mounting on a shaft. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support. These bearing has a full complement design. The absence of a cage allows for a greater number of rolling elements, making this track roller radially highly loadable. Full complement track rollers are also more shock-resistant than track rollers with a cage. However, the maximum rotational speed is lower than that of caged variants. Common applications of track rollers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam mechanisms. EEM= Metal Seals Two side.

Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. Yoke type track rollers are suitable for mounting on a shaft. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support. These bearing has a full complement design. The absence of a cage allows for a greater number of rolling elements, making this track roller radially highly loadable. Full complement track rollers are also more shock-resistant than track rollers with a cage. However, the maximum rotational speed is lower than that of caged variants. Common applications of track rollers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam mechanisms. EE =Rubber Seal on Two Sides, SW=Cam Followers Without Stud With Optimized Profile.

THREAD (M5 x 0.8). The RAL bearing is a ball-bearing stud type track roller or cam follower, of which the rolling elements combine low friction with high precision. Cam followers are designed for use with various types of tracks. Thanks to a thick-walled outer ring, they can withstand high radial loads. These bearing is a equipped with a cage that prevents the rolling elements from coming into contact with each other. This design allows for a controlled movement of the rolling elements. The GCU bearing is a cam follower with needle rollers. These rolling elements combine high load capacity with a compact design. Cam followers are designed for use with various types of tracks. Thanks to a thick-walled outer ring, they can withstand high radial loads. Instead of an inner ring, they feature a solid, threaded stud, enabling easy mounting. Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support. These bearing has a full complement design. The absence of a cage allows for a greater number of rolling elements, making this cam follower radially highly loadable. Full complement cam followers are also more shock-resistant than cam followers with a cage. However, the maximum rotational speed is lower than that of caged variants. Common applications of cam followers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam mechanisms.

The designs provide maximum cage strength consistent with the inherent high loadratings of needle roller bearings. Radial needle roller and cage assembly must be axially guided by shoulders or other suitable means. The end guiding surfaces should be hardened to minimize wear and must provide sufficient axial clearance to prevent end-locking of the assembly. Use the housing bore as the outer raceway and the shaft as the inner raceway.

desc: INNER RING FOR NEEDLE ROLLER BEARING
tech: Inner Rings are made of rolling bearing steel and after hardening, their bores, raceways and end surfaces are ground. Inner rings may be used to provide inner raceway surfaces for radial needle roller and cage assemblies, needle roller bearings and needle bushes. Inner rings are available in four basic designs and differ only by the chamfers at the ends of the raceway surfaces, the lubricant access holes and the raceway profile. Inner rings of series JR have chamfers to assist in bearing installation but are without lubricating holes. Inner rings of series JR.JS1 have bearing installation chamfers and lubricating holes (bore diameters 5 to 50 mm). Inner rings of series JRZ.JS1 are without installation chamfers, allowing for maximum possible raceway contact.

Inner rings may be used to provide inner raceway surfaces for radial needle roller and cage assemblies, needle roller bearings and needle bushes. Inner rings are available in four basic designs and differ only by the chamfers at the ends of the raceway surfaces, the lubricant access holes and the raceway profile. Inner rings of series JR have chamfers to assist in bearing installation but are without lubricating holes. Inner rings of series JR.JS1 have bearing installation chamfers and lubricating holes (bore diameters 5 to 50 mm). Inner rings of series JRZ.JS1 are without installation chamfers, allowing for maximum possible raceway contact.

The NUKR...2SK bearing is a cam follower with cylindrical rollers. These rolling elements combine a high load capacity with reasonable shock resistance. Cam followers are designed for use with various types of tracks. Thanks to a thick-walled outer ring, they can withstand high radial loads. Instead of an inner ring, they feature a solid, threaded stud, enabling easy mounting. Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support. These bearings has a full complement design. The absence of a cage allows for a greater number of rolling elements, making this cam follower radially highly loadable. Full complement cam followers are also more shock-resistant than cam followers with a cage. However, the maximum rotational speed is lower than that of caged variants. Common applications of cam followers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam followers. 2SK=Two Hexagonal Socket In Flange End.

desc: INNER RING FOR NEEDLE ROLLER BEARING
tech: The Nadella IM series is a high-precision inner ring specifically designed for use with Nadella needle roller bearings. It serves as a hardened and ground raceway for needle rollers in applications where the shaft itself cannot be properly treated to act as a bearing surface. This inner ring is specifically engineered for use with Nadella\'s RAXN and RAXNPZ combined needle bearings, which handle simultaneous radial and axial loads. Material : High-quality through-hardened bearing steel (Chrome Steel). Features are : Load Distribution, Compact Footprint, Lubrication Management, Wide Temperature Range, Ease of Assembly, High Precision. Applications : Machine Tools & CNC, Textile Machinery, Printing & Packaging, Industrial Pumps & Compressors, Material Handling & Robotics, HVAC Systems, Agricultural Equipment, Metal Cutting and Stamping, Heavy Industrial Transmissions, Gear pumps.

Track rollers are designed for use with various types of tracks. Thanks to a thick-walled outer ring, they can withstand high radial loads. Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. Yoke type track rollers are suitable for mounting on a shaft. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support. PWTR : Bearing Type.

desc: NATR YOKE TYPE TRACK ROLLERS  NATR 55 PP
tech: Track roller or support roller with needle rollers. These rolling elements combine high load capacity with a compact design. Track rollers are designed for use with various types of tracks. This series a thick-walled outer ring, they can withstand high radial loads. Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. Yoke type track rollers are suitable for mounting on a shaft. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support. Equipped with a cage that prevents the rolling elements from coming into contact with each other. This design allows for a controlled movement of the rolling elements. There is lower friction compared to full complement track rollers, allowing for higher rotational speeds and less heat generation. Common applications of support rollers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam mechanisms. PP : Lip Seals On Both Sides (P Type - Two Zinc-Plated Sheet Steel Washers With Intermediate NBR Part, Seal Lip Axially Preloaded), X : Cylindrical Running Surface. Temperature Range -30 ~ 100℃.
