Thread=M4X0.7. The RJ-C series is a specific part number for a studded track roller. It is a component designed for use in conveying systems and similar applications where the roller moves along a track. These rollers feature a thick-walled outer ring and an integral threaded stud for cantilever mounting to a component. They are designed to support high radial loads and can tolerate some axial loads due to minor misalignments or skewed running. Material : Manufactured from high-carbon bearing steel (52100) or high-alloy steel. Features are : Integral Heavy-Duty Stud, Ease of Installation, High-Speed Stability, Misalignment Tolerance, High-Load Capacity, Maintenance-Free Life, Low-Friction. Applications : Conveyor Systems, Material Handling & Lifting, Packaging and Printing, Textile Machinery, Medical and Laboratory Equipment, Automated Warehousing, Food Processing, Machine Tools. C=Crowned Outer Ring.

Thread=MX0.7. The RJ-W Studded Track Roller is a heavy-duty, ready-to-fit rolling bearing assembly designed to operate on all types of tracks and to be used in cam drives and conveyor systems. These rollers consist of a thick-walled outer ring designed to withstand high radial loads and sudden impacts. Instead of a standard inner ring, they feature a heavy-section threaded stud for direct mounting. Material : Usually manufactured from hardened bearing steel. Features are : High Load Capacity, Precision Mounting, Self-Retaining Unit, Corrosion Resistance, Reduced Friction, Lower Maintenance. Applications : Conveyor Systems, Machine Tools, Packaging & Printing, Construction and Mining Equipment, Food & Medical Technology, Steel & Foundry Equipment. W=Crowned (Radius) Outer Ring.

Thread=MX0.7. The RJ-EW series is a specialized stud-type track roller (also known as a cam follower) designed for heavy-duty industrial applications. It consists of a thick-walled outer ring that rolls directly on a track, supported by a heavy-section integral stud instead of a standard inner ring. This design allows for cantilever mounting using a fixing thread on the stud end. Material: High-grade Bearing Steel (hardened to 60-65 HRC). Features are : High Load Capacity, Axial Load Tolerance, Shock & Fatigue Resistance, Fixing Thread & Installation Aid, Vibration & Noise Dampening, Corrosion Resistance Options, High Rigidity for Oscillating Motion, Integrated Lubrication Path, Speed Capability. Applications : Automotive Assembly, Automated Storage and Retrieval Systems, Food & Pharmaceutical Production, Conveyor Systems, Architectural & Glass Work, Metal & Mining, Printing & Paper. E=Eccentric Bushing, W=Enhanced Sealing.

Thread=MX0.7. The LJ-C series is a high-performance, concentric studded track roller engineered for precision linear guidance systems. The LJ-C features a double-row ball bearing architecture. This allows it to handle significantly higher radial loads and axial thrust compared to single-row rollers. Material : Typically high-carbon bearing steel. Features are : High Speed & Quiet Operation, Self-Cleaning Action, Low Friction, Enhanced Vibration Dampening, Space-Saving Footprint, Maintenance & Longevity, Misalignment Tolerance, High Moment Stiffness. Applications : Medical Testing Machinery, Pharmaceutical Packaging,  Semiconductor & Electronics, Packaging Machinery, Food & Beverage, Aerospace & Vacuum, Material Handling. C= Concentric.

Features are : High Speed & Quiet Operation, Self-Cleaning Action, Low Friction, Enhanced Vibration Dampening, Space-Saving Footprint, Maintenance & Longevity, Misalignment Tolerance, High Moment Stiffness. The Nadella PR series is a specialized adjustment plate within the Rolbloc Linear Guide System, designed specifically for heavy-duty industrial applications. It serves as a critical mounting component that enables precise alignment and leveling for Rolbloc carriages. The PR series is used to facilitate \"high compensation\" during mounting. This allows the linear system to be installed on surfaces that may not be perfectly flat or aligned, ensuring the carriage rollers maintain optimal contact with the rails. Like all Rolbloc components, the PR bearing is specifically designed for dirty and aggressive environments containing dust, abrasives, or corrosive elements. Features are : High Temperature Tolerance, Extreme Load Capacity, Lightweight, High Strength, Shock Absorption. Applications : Foundries and Steel Mills, Steel Fabrication Equipment, Material Elevators and Vertical Lifts, Automatic Warehouses, Stone and Marble Industry, Food and Beverage Processing, Medical and Healthcare Equipment, Renewable Energy.

This allows the linear system to be installed on surfaces that may not be perfectly flat or aligned, ensuring the carriage rollers maintain optimal contact with the rails. Like all Rolbloc components, the PR bearing is specifically designed for dirty and aggressive environments containing dust, abrasives, or corrosive elements. Features are : High Temperature Tolerance, Extreme Load Capacity, Lightweight, High Strength, Shock Absorption. Applications : Foundries and Steel Mills, Steel Fabrication Equipment, Material Elevators and Vertical Lifts, Automatic Warehouses, Stone and Marble Industry, Food and Beverage Processing, Medical and Healthcare Equipment, Renewable Energy.

The DIST FS series refers to a specific Nadella linear guide rail (part of the FS series). The components for this system, such as bearings, are typically sold separately or as part of a complete linear guide system. These are designed to run along the guide rail. Nadella produces various types, including those with full complement needle rollers for high load capacity and rigidity. These are used in applications requiring high load capacity within limited space. Used in linear guide systems, often in combination with guide rollers, to create circular, oval, or ring-shaped motion circuits. Material : The standard rails are made of steel. The raceways (running surfaces) are induction hardened to ensure durability and handle high loads.The rails have the same section dimensions as straight FS M rails and are joined using alignment blocks to ensure precise assembly. Applications : Robotics & Automation, Packaging & Processing, Machine Tools, Material Handling, Woodworking & Plastics, Medical & Precision Instruments, Printing & Paper Processing, Aerospace Components.

The Nadella DIST FSH series is a guide rail component of the modular V-Line linear guidance system. It is designed for precise linear movements in medium to high load applications, even in aggressive industrial environments. The \"FSH \" bearing refers to a specific size of the Nadella FSH guide rail system. These rails are used with Nadella\'s combined bearings (which contain both radial needle rollers and axial ball bearings or rollers) to create a linear guidance system. Material : Made of steel with ground raceways, typically rust-resistant, making it suitable for various environmental conditions including wet areas like water jet cutting systems. Features are : High Load & Speed Capability, Self-Cleaning Profile, Integrated Lubrication, Misalignment Compensation. Applications : Factory Automation & Robotics, Machine Tools & Fabrication, Packaging & Printing, Food & Medical Sectors, Material Handling & Logistics, Medical & Electromedical Devices, Renewable Energy, Textile Manufacturing.

The DIST FSX  Nadella is a specific spacer (distance sleeve) used in V-Line linear guide systems. Its primary function is to ensure correct installation and spacing for the associated FSX 90 guide roller or cam follower, enabling precise operation within industrial applications. The DIST FSX  spacer is an essential component for mounting Nadella guide rollers onto a linear guide system. Maintain the precise distance and alignment between components, which is crucial for optimal performance of the V-line system in high-speed and high-acceleration applications. Distribute strain over a wider contact surface during installation, contributing to a robust and reliable assembly. Ensure proper functionality of the guide roller within the linear guide, preventing misalignment that could compromise the system\'s performance. The spacer is made from steel or hardened and ground bearing steel, consistent with other Nadella components designed for high load capacity and precision. Applications : Assembly machines, Packaging machines, Machine tools, Printing machines, Water jet cutting systems.

THREAD=M10= The Nadella LUBZ series is a specific configuration within the LUBZ (or LUBY) series of automatic lubricators, which are essential components in linear motion technology for ensuring the longevity and smooth performance of guide rollers and rails, especially in high-speed and demanding industrial applications. The primary purpose is to consistently lubricate the raceways (hardened steel tracks) that the guide rollers run on, which minimizes friction, reduces wear, and extends the operational life of the entire system.It typically consists of a compact unit, often with a plastic or aluminum body, containing a felt insert that holds the lubricant and applies it directly to the rail surface as the carriage moves. Application : These lubricators are typically integrated into the linear carriage of multi-axis systems, manipulators, and automated machinery where consistent, reliable lubrication is required and manual greasing is impractical. They are designed for easy installation and maintenance, often being described as \"maintenance-free\" in operation due to their self-lubricating design once installed correctly. D=Without Pre-Applied Lubricant.

desc: INNER RING FOR NEEDLE ROLLER BEARING

desc: INNER RING FOR NEEDLE ROLLER BEARING

The Nadella IM series is an inner ring designed for use with needle roller bearings. The primary function of an inner ring like the IM series is to serve as the inner raceway for a needle roller assembly when it is impractical to meet the necessary hardness (58-64 HRC) and surface finish requirements on the actual shaft. Material : The rings are made of high-quality, through-hardened or case-hardened bearing steel to withstand high stress and wear. Nadella inner rings are designed for applications requiring high load capacity and precision within compact radial spaces. They are engineered for durability when properly lubricated and installed according to manufacturer guidelines, including appropriate tolerances and form deviations on the mating parts.

desc: MALE THREAD ROD END BEARING (RIGHT HAND THREAD)
tech: THREAD= M12. Right Hand Thread Rod Ends (Roller bearing - Mounting sizes acc. to DIN ISO 12240-4 dimension series K). Inner ring: Antifriction bearing steel. hardened. high precision machined. Rolling element: Barrel roller bearings made from through-hardened. antrifriction bearing steel. Housing: Steel with bearing outer ring pressed into housing. raceway precision ground. Lubrication: The rod ends are given initail lubrication. Retainer: Synthetic material. All Askubal spherical bearings and rod ends can be used without restriction in an operating temperature range of between -10 °C bis +80 °C. All are very high precision. ready-to-fit bearing elements. ZZ=Two Metallic Shields, NR=Snap Ring Groove In Bearing Outer Ring And Appropriate Snap Ring.

The S-STK2RS series is a sealed, maintenance-required spherical plain bearing. These bearing is a spherical plain bearing, which consists of an inner ring and an outer ring with spherical sliding surfaces, allowing for swiveling, tilting, and rotational movements to compensate for misalignments without edge pressure. The \"STK2RS\" designation specifically means it is a maintenance-required type with rubber seals on both sides (2RS) to protect internal components from contaminants. It features a steel-on-bronze sliding contact surface. The steel inner ring contacts the bronze surface of the outer ring. This pairing offers high wear resistance and low friction, though its maximum load capacity is slightly lower compared to steel-on-steel variants. Material : It is typically constructed from high-quality bearing steel, often with the inner ring hard chromium plated at the sliding surface, hardened, ground, and polished. Features are : Self-Aligning Capability, Maintenance Required, Wide Operating Temperature Range. Applications : Pumps and compressors, Automation and Robotics, Packaging and textile machines, Material Handling Systems, Mining and Quarrying, Pneumatic and Hydraulic Cylinders.

These series is a spherical plain bearing. Spherical plain bearings are two-piece plain bearings. They have no rolling elements, but consist of an inner and outer ring. The inner ring has a convex outer surface. The outer ring has a concave inner surface. This construction gives spherical plain bearings their high load carrying capacity and capacity to accommodate misalignment. These bearings has a steel-on-PTFE sliding contact which makes it maintenance-free. PTFE is a special plastic. During the run-in period of these plain bearings, particles of PTFE are deposited on the opposite running surface. They fill in the small irregularities of the inner ring surface, creating a smooth surface. As a result, the components fit each other perfectly. FW=Sliding Contact Surface Hard Chromium/PTFE (Polyetrafluoroethylene) Composite, Wide Inner Ring.

These bearing is a high-precision, low-maintenance spherical plain bearing that utilizes barrel roller bearings and double-sided sealing discs. These series is a part of the G-20200 series, characterized by an integrated roller bearing design within a spherical housing. It is part of the G series, dimension series K according to DIN ISO 12240-4, and is a low-maintenance, ready-to-fit component. This design allows for smooth rotation and tilting movements, making it more robust than standard plain spherical bearings in certain high-frequency applications. Material : The inner and outer rings are made from hardened anti-friction bearing steel. Features are : High Load Capacity, Misalignment Compensation, Low Maintenance, Optimized Temperature Range, Precision Engineering. Applications : Materials Handling and Conveying, Automation and Robotics, Plant Construction and Engineering, Power Generation, Construction and Mining Machinery, Agricultural Machinery, Marine Systems, Medical Technology, Pneumatics Industry. RS= Rubber Seal on One Side.

These bearing is a specific spherical plain bearing with roller bearings from the manufacturer ASKUBAL. It is designed to accommodate heavy radial loads and angular misalignments in oscillating applications, featuring integrated sealing for reduced maintenance.  It is a spherical plain bearing with roller elements, not a plain sliding contact bearing. The \"G-20200\" series designation confirms it as a roller bearing type, offering high load-carrying capacity in primarily the radial direction. It is part of the G series, dimension series K according to DIN ISO 12240-4, and is a low-maintenance, ready-to-fit component. Features are : Self-Aligning Capability, High Impact Load Resistance, Accommodates Misalignment, Low Friction Characteristics, Low Maintenance, Optimized for Oscillation. Application : Construction and Mining Machinery, Hydraulic Cylinders, Material Handling and Conveyors, Robotics and Automation, Agriculture and Forestry Equipment, General Industrial Machinery, Rail and Vehicle Engineering, Renewable Energy, Food & Beverage Processing, Textile Machinery. RS= Rubber Seal on One Side, V=Internal Configuration.

These bearing is an Askubal spherical bearing with roller bearings.  These bearing is a ready-to-fit bearing element that uses barrel roller bearings instead of a plain sliding surface. This design makes its function comparable to self-aligning ball bearings or spherical roller bearings. It is particularly effective for use with alternating loads, large swivel movements, and full rotations at medium to high speeds. The spherical outer ring raceway and barrel rolling elements allow for angular adjustment, enabling it to compensate for misalignments between the shaft and the housing without creating edge pressure. Its dimensions comply with DIN ISO 12240-4 dimension series K. Material : The inner ring, outer ring, and barrel rolling elements are all made from through-hardened, high-precision machined antifriction bearing steel. The retainer (cage) is constructed from a robust synthetic material. Applications : Materials Handling and Conveying Equipment, Agricultural Machinery, Hydraulic and Pneumatic Systems, Construction and Mining Equipment, Textile Machinery and Robotics, Medical and Laboratory Equipment. ZZ= Metal Shields (covering discs) On Both Sides.

desc: FEMALE THREAD ROD END BEARING (RIGHT HAND THREAD)
tech: Thread = M8. The ASKUBAL KI-440 is a specific female-threaded, maintenance-free rod end  from the dimension series K, engineered for high-performance applications such as those in motorsport and general mechanical engineering. Rod ends consist of a housing with an integral shank and a spherical plain bearing, used to transmit forces and movements while compensating for angular misalignment. The KI-440 is a maintenance-free version, meaning it does not require constant re-lubrication, unlike the standard \"KI \" series which has steel-on-bronze sliding contact and requires grease. The \"440\" in the part number indicates specific material and design features for motorsport use, particularly a steel/PTFE sliding pairing. Features are : Angular Compensation, High Load Capacity, Precision and Reliability, Reduced Bearing Clearance, Wide Operating Temperature, Corrosion Protection. Applications : Hydraulic and Pneumatic Systems, Mechanical and Plant Engineering, Automation and Robotics, Heavy Equipment, Steering Linkages, Textile Machinery, Printing Presses, Mining Equipment, Energy and Power Plants, Food Processing.

Features are : High Load Carrying Capacity, Misalignment Compensation, Reduced Bearing Clearance, Wide Operating Temperature Range, Long Service Life. Applications : Automation and Robotics, Heavy Machinery/Construction Equipment, Agricultural Technology, Plant and General Mechanical Engineering, Transport and Logistics, Medical Technology. These bearing is a central washer (axial bearing washer) designed for use with needle roller thrust bearings. It provides a hardened raceway surface when adjacent machine components are not suitable for direct contact with the rolling elements. These bearing belongs to the INA ZS series of metric center washers for thrust bearings, which are suitable for combination with axial needle roller and cage assemblies, such as the AXK series, and K811 series bearings. This component forms the running surface for the rolling elements in an axial (thrust) bearing arrangement. It is a center washer design, meaning it is guided by either the housing or the shaft, and is designed for double direction axial bearing combinations. Material: The washer is made from through-hardened rolling bearing steel, and its running surfaces are precision-machined as rolling element raceways, ensuring durability and heat tolerance under heavy loads. Features are : Enhanced Efficiency, High Operational Security, Wide Temperature Range, Compactness, Longer Service Life, Space-Saving. Applications : Automotive Transmissions and Clutches, Pumps and Compressors, Industrial Gearboxes, Agricultural and Construction Equipment, Machine Tools, Material Handling Equipment, Printing Machinery.

These bearing belongs to the INA ZS series of metric center washers for thrust bearings, which are suitable for combination with axial needle roller and cage assemblies, such as the AXK series, and K811 series bearings. This component forms the running surface for the rolling elements in an axial (thrust) bearing arrangement. It is a center washer design, meaning it is guided by either the housing or the shaft, and is designed for double direction axial bearing combinations. Material: The washer is made from through-hardened rolling bearing steel, and its running surfaces are precision-machined as rolling element raceways, ensuring durability and heat tolerance under heavy loads. Features are : Enhanced Efficiency, High Operational Security, Wide Temperature Range, Compactness, Longer Service Life, Space-Saving. Applications : Automotive Transmissions and Clutches, Pumps and Compressors, Industrial Gearboxes, Agricultural and Construction Equipment, Machine Tools, Material Handling Equipment, Printing Machinery.

The CRSBR bearing is a type of cam follower (stud type roller bearing). It is designed for applications where the outer ring runs on a track and features a thick-walled outer ring to withstand heavy rolling and shock loads. Cam Follower, Stud Type, Non-Separate Roller Follower. The \"SBR\" in the part number indicates a sealed, hex socket head with a cylindrical (flat) outer ring. It has a compact design with a full complement of needle rollers, providing a very high radial load-carrying capacity for its size. The solid outer race enables high rigidity. Material: The bearing components, including the inner and outer rings and needle rollers, are generally made from through-hardened, high-carbon chromium steel for durability and heat tolerance. The stud is made of carburized steel for better fracture resistance. Features are : High Radial Load Capacity, Shock Load Resistance, Longer Service Life, Easy Mounting, Low Coefficient of Friction, Compact Design, Smooth Motion. Applications : Material Handling & Conveyors, Automation & Robotics, Packaging & Bottling, Machine Tools & CNC, Printing & Textiles, Railways & Logistics.

The CRSBE bearing is an inch-series, eccentric stud-type needle cam follower designed to handle moderate radial and shock loads in industrial applications like conveyor systems and machine tools. Its eccentric stud design allows for precise radial adjustment during installation to ensure proper alignment and load distribution. This is a non-separable, stud-type track roller bearing with a thick-walled outer ring to minimize deformation under heavy loads. The \"E\" in the part number indicates an eccentric stud, which allows the outer ring\'s radial position to be adjusted relative to the running surface. Material: The bearing is made from high carbon, high chromium bearing steel and treated with a black oxide finish for corrosion resistance. Internal thrust washers are made of a self-lubricating resin to help reduce sliding friction. Features are : Non-Separable, Sealed Unit, Optimal Load Distribution, Reduced Friction Components, Precision and Alignment, Wide Temperature Range, Smooth Operation. Applications : Conveyor and Transfer Systems, Automation and Robotics, Machine Tools and CNC Machinery, Packaging and Bottling Machinery, Automotive and Aerospace Manufacturing.

The CRSBCE bearing is an eccentric stud type, sealed, crowned needle cam follower designed to handle high radial loads and shock loads in cam mechanisms or linear motion systems. Material: Made from high-alloy bearing quality carbon steel. The WSSB bearing is a spherical plain bearing. Spherical plain bearings are two-piece plain bearings. They have no rolling elements, but consist of an inner and outer ring. They fill in the small irregularities of the inner ring surface, creating a smooth surface. As a result, the components fit each other perfectly.

THREAD=M5. The SPHS-EC bearing is a rod end. Rod ends consist of a housing with integral shank and a spherical plain bearing. These bearubg has a spherical plain bearing with a steel-on-PTFE sliding contact, making it maintenance-free. PTFE is a special plastic. UNF 10-32. The JM bearing is a high-precision, inch-series male rod end bearing (also known as a Heim joint) featuring a robust three-piece construction. Applications: Laboratory Automation, Automotive and Transportation, Alternator Tensioners, Light Industrial Equipment, Printing and Packaging, HVAC Louver Controls, Textile Machinery, Motorsports Steering & Gear Shifts, Marine Control Systems.

Material : The housing is made of zinc-plated carbon steel, while the ball (inner ring) is heat-treated GCr15 bearing steel with a chromium-plated spherical surface. Features are : Radial Load Capacity, Precision Rating, Vibration Damping, Automated Quality Control, Vibration & Noise Testing, Extreme Temperature Capability. Applications : Automotive and Motorsports, Textile and Printing, Packaging and Conveying, Construction Vehicles, Agricultural Equipment, Medical Robotics, CNC Equipment, Robotic Articulation, Aerospace & Defense, Marine Applications. Y=Integrated Press-in Stud.

UNF 10-32. The JF bearing is a rod end. Rod ends consist of a housing with integral shank and a spherical plain bearing. This plain bearing is composed of an inner and outer ring without rolling elements. Rod ends are often mounted on the end of hydraulic or pneumatic cylinders. They are also used to connect two shafts. Rod ends can accommodate misalignment, and they support radial forces in a tensile or compressive direction. These bearing has a spherical plain bearing with a steel-on-bronze sliding contact. The steel inner ring contacts the bronze surface of the outer ring. The steel-on-bronze sliding contact makes this bearing highly wear-resistant, providing low friction. However, the load capacity is slightly lower compared to spherical plain bearings with steel-on-steel sliding contacts. This bearing needs regular maintenance. Proper lubrication is required to reduce friction and prevent fouling and corrosion.

The SK...ES bearing is a heavy-duty, weldable hydraulic rod end bearing designed for extreme industrial environments. It is a metric-sized component consisting of a weldable carbon steel housing and a high-performance GE 70 ES spherical plain bearing, specifically engineered for welding onto hydraulic cylinder rods or piston bases. Material : The housing is made of weldable carbon steel featuring a 45° welding chamfer to facilitate a strong bond with the cylinder rod. The internal bearing rings are made from GCr15 bearing steel. Inner ring heat-treated to HRC 58-64 for extreme hardness and the outer ring heat-treated to HRC 54-60. Features are : Extreme Temperature Rating, Concentricity Optimization, Heavy-Duty Staking, Advanced Lubrication Architecture, Load-Specific Structural Design, Environmental Adaptability. Applications : Construction & Earthmoving, Mining Machinery, Material Handling, Forging & Metalworking, Agricultural & Forestry Equipment, Marine & Offshore Applications, Power Generation, Printing Machinery, Waste Management, Energy & M.ining. ES=Steel-on-Steel.

The GE-ET-2RS Neutral is a spherical plain bearing. Spherical plain bearings are two-piece plain bearings. They have no rolling elements, but consist of an inner and outer ring. The inner ring has a convex outer surface. The outer ring has a concave inner surface. This construction gives spherical plain bearings their high load carrying capacity and capacity to accommodate misalignment. These bearing has a steel-on-PTFE sliding contact which makes it maintenance-free. PTFE is a special plastic. During the run-in period of these plain bearings, particles of PTFE are deposited on the opposite running surface. They fill in the small irregularities of the inner ring surface, creating a smooth surface. As a result, the components fit each other perfectly. ET=Through Hardened And Ground Steel Fractured At One Point, 2RS=Double-Lip Rubbing Seals Of Metric Bearings Are Made Of Polyester Elastomer (-30°C ~ 130°C). Inch-Size Bearings Are Made Of Polyurethane (-20°C ~ 80°C).

Unlike simpler two-piece designs, the SCOS uses a three-piece structure (housing, race, and ball), which typically provides a more stable sliding contact and better handles oscillating movements. Material : The internal ball is crafted from 440 stainless steel, which is heat-treated to a minimum hardness of HRC56, precision ground, and polished for smooth rotation. The body is made of SUS304 stainless steel with a turned surface finish, providing high resistance to oxidation and chemical exposure. Features are : Wide Temperature Range, Self-Aligning Capability, Strict Quality Control, Lightweight Compactness, Washdown Capability, Reduced Vibration and Noise, Fatigue Life & Tensile Strength. Applications : Textile Machinery, Packaging Equipment, Pneumatic & Hydraulic Cylinders, Robotic Arms, Food Processing, Medical Devices, Chemical Processing, Aerospace & Aviation, Marine Equipment.

The SGE...ET-2RS bearing is a high-performance stainless steel radial spherical plain bearing. It is a maintenance-free, self-lubricating component designed for heavy radial and combined loads in environments where corrosion resistance is critical. The outer race is intentionally single-fractured to allow for the assembly of the inner ball. Applications : Food and Beverage Machinery, Chemical Industry, Medical Equipment, Hydraulic and Mechanical Actuation, Agricultural and Mining Equipment, Aerospace and Defense, Renewable Energy, Marine and Offshore Engineering, Packaging Machinery, 3D Printing and CNC Tool Changers. ET=Steel-On-PTFE fabric, 2RS=Rubber Contact Seals On Both Sides.

The WSSB bearing is a spherical plain bearing. Spherical plain bearings are two-piece plain bearings. They have no rolling elements, but consist of an inner and outer ring. The inner ring has a convex outer surface. The outer ring has a concave inner surface. This construction gives spherical plain bearings their high load carrying capacity and capacity to accommodate misalignment. These bearings has a steel-on-PTFE sliding contact which makes it maintenance-free. PTFE is a special plastic. During the run-in period of these plain bearings, particles of PTFE are deposited on the opposite running surface. They fill in the small irregularities of the inner ring surface, creating a smooth surface. As a result, the components fit each other perfectly. V= V-Groove.

This is a bushing. Bushings have a very simple, one-piece cylindrical design without rolling elements. Instead, they have a sliding contact where the shaft slides into the bore. This construction makes these bushings a cost-effective and reliable solution. Additionally, they are easy to install and require little installation space. The direct contact between the bushing and the shaft results in greater friction between the surfaces. Compared to roller bearings, they have lower speed and load capacities. Bushings are primarily used for rotating, oscillating, and linear movements. Material : Metal-polymer composite. Features are : Self-Lubricating, Low Friction & Wear, Space-Saving Design, High Chemical Resistance, Versatile Motion, Thermal Stability, Vibration Damping, Maintenance-Free. Applications: Suspension Systems, Chassis Components, Hydraulic and Pneumatic Equipment, Industrial and Agricultural Machinery, Household and Office Equipment, Construction Machinery, Energy and Infrastructure, Aerospace and Transportation.

desc: CAM FOLLOWERS WITH LUBRI-DISC SEALS & NON-METALLIC BUSHINGS
tech: BCF-S SERIES BUSHING TYPE is a non-metallic bushing replaces rollers and provides load support and a sliding motion that eliminates or reduces need for bearing lubrication. BCF stands for Bushing Cam Follower—i.e. instead of needle rollers, this type uses a non-metallic bearing bushing internally. The suffix S indicates that it is a sealed version, using LUBRI-DISC® seals on the ends to retain lubricant and prevent contamination. These are stud-mount cam followers, meaning they mount via a stud (threaded stem) into a housing or fixture (rather than yoke / shaft mounting). Low Maintenance / Maintenance-Free, Reduced Noise / Friction, Cleaner Operation, Simplicity & Reliability, Shock Capability.

desc: CAM FOLLOWERS WITH HEX HOLE, LUBRI-DISC SEALS & NON-METALLIC BUSHINGS
tech: BCF-SB indicates a bushing-type, sealed, stud-mount cam follower. desc: INNER RING FOR NEEDLE ROLLER BEARING
tech: The Nadella BIC bearing is a specific needle roller bearing inner ring. It is not a complete bearing on its own but is designed to be used with a needle roller and cage assembly, serving as the inner raceway for the needle rollers when the shaft itself cannot be used for that purpose. The bearing is manufactured from high-quality chrome steel by Nadella. The BIC series is typically mounted with a tight interference fit in the housing bore. This enables a simple and economical design, as shoulders or snap rings are not required for axial location. Material : High-quality chrome steel (SAE 52100 equivalent). Features are : High Load Capacity, Compact Design, Durability and Precision, Axial Displacement, Ease of Assembly. Applications : Automotive transmissions and gearboxes, Pumps and compressors, Industrial presses and conveyors, Heavy-duty industrial setups, Packaging Machinery, Medical Equipment.

desc: INNER RING FOR NEEDLE ROLLER BEARING
tech: The Nadella BICG series is a specific type of cylindrical inner ring designed for use with needle roller bearings. In the Nadella numbering system, the \"BICG\" series refers to inner rings with a lubrication hole, which allows for re-lubrication through the shaft. The \"BICG\" series, this ring is wider than standard rings, providing a larger \"backrest\" for the shaft and better distribution of radial forces over a wider contact area. Material : Manufactured from high-grade through-hardened bearing steel (typically SAE 52100). Features are : High Dynamic Capacity, Tolerance Standards, Axial Displacement Accommodation, Operational Speeds, Space-Saving Systems, Simplified Shaft Design, Temperature Versatilit, Maintenance Efficiency. Applications : Motion Control Systems, Power Transmission, Industrial Gearboxes, Hydraulic Pumps and Motors, Printing Presses, Textile Machinery, Packaging Lines, Material Handling Cranes, Machine Tool Spindles, Medical Equipment.

The \"BICG\" series, this ring is wider than standard rings, providing a larger \"backrest\" for the shaft and better distribution of radial forces over a wider contact area. Material : Manufactured from high-grade through-hardened bearing steel (typically SAE 52100). Features are : High Dynamic Capacity, Tolerance Standards, Axial Displacement Accommodation, Operational Speeds, Space-Saving Systems, Simplified Shaft Design, Temperature Versatilit, Maintenance Efficiency. Applications : Motion Control Systems, Power Transmission, Industrial Gearboxes, Hydraulic Pumps and Motors, Printing Presses, Textile Machinery, Packaging Lines, Material Handling Cranes, Machine Tool Spindles, Medical Equipment.

desc: INNER RING FOR NEEDLE ROLLER BEARING
tech: The Nadella BIP series is a wide cylindrical inner ring designed for full complement needle roller bearings, specifically for the RNA 1000 series. It is a precision component used to provide a hardened raceway for needle rollers when the shaft itself cannot be ground and hardened. The BIP prefix specifically denotes a wide cylindrical inner ring without a lubrication hole, designed for the RNA 1000 series. Material : Manufactured from high-quality chrome steel (100Cr6), providing durability and high load resistance. Features are : Separable Components, Load and Speed Capacity, Tolerance Standards, Axial Displacement, Temperature Range, Misalignment Handling, High-Speed Capacity, Stress Management, Friction Minimization, Reduced Maintenance Costs. Applications : Automotive Systems, Power Transmission, Robotics & Automation, Machine Tool Spindles, Agricultural Equipment, Medical Technology, Printing & Packaging, Textile Machinery.

desc: INNER RING FOR NEEDLE ROLLER BEARING
tech: The Nadella IM series is a high-precision inner ring specifically designed for use with Nadella needle roller bearings. It serves as a hardened and ground raceway for needle rollers in applications where the shaft itself cannot be properly treated to act as a bearing surface. This inner ring is specifically engineered for use with Nadella\\\'s RAXN and RAXNPZ combined needle bearings, which handle simultaneous radial and axial loads. Material : High-quality through-hardened bearing steel (Chrome Steel). Features are : Load Distribution, Compact Footprint, Lubrication Management, Wide Temperature Range, Ease of Assembly, High Precision. Applications : Machine Tools & CNC, Textile Machinery, Printing & Packaging, Industrial Pumps & Compressors, Material Handling & Robotics, HVAC Systems, Agricultural Equipment, Metal Cutting and Stamping, Heavy Industrial Transmissions, Gear pumps.

desc: INNER RING FOR NEEDLE ROLLER BEARING
tech: Needle rollers can be used to design full complement bearing arrangements for low-speed or oscillating applications. These compact bearing arrangements have a very high load carrying capacity when compared to bearings with a cage and are economical, provided the shaft and housing bore can serve as raceways raceways on shafts and in housings. They are made of carbon chromium steel, have a hardness of 58 to 65 HRC and have a precision ground surface. Main dimensions according to DIN 620. Features are : They are made of hardened rolling bearing steel, They have a precision machined raceway, The chamfers at the front sides make possible an easy insertion into the bearing and prevent damages at the seal lip.

These compact bearing arrangements have a very high load carrying capacity when compared to bearings with a cage and are economical, provided the shaft and housing bore can serve as raceways raceways on shafts and in housings. They are made of carbon chromium steel, have a hardness of 58 to 65 HRC and have a precision ground surface. Main dimensions according to DIN 620. Features are : They are made of hardened rolling bearing steel, They have a precision machined raceway, The chamfers at the front sides make possible an easy insertion into the bearing and prevent damages at the seal lip.

desc: INNER RING FOR NEEDLE ROLLER BEARING

Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, this inner ring is designed to accommodate needle rollers, facilitating smooth and efficient rotation within the bearing assembly. Feature are : high-quality standards, ensuring proper fit, durability, and efficient performance in various applications, Contributing to the overall reliability and longevity of the bearing system.

Instead of an inner ring, they feature a solid, threaded stud, enabling easy mounting. Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support. These bearing has a full complement design. The absence of a cage allows for a greater number of rolling elements, making this cam follower radially highly loadable. Full complement cam followers are also more shock-resistant than cam followers with a cage. However, the maximum rotational speed is lower than that of caged variants. Common applications of cam followers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam mechanisms. B=Cam Follower, Camrol, Hexagonal Hole Replaces Screwdriver Slot In Flange End Of Stem.

desc: MCF-BX METRIC CAMROL FULL COMPLEMENT (UNSEALED) BEARING
tech: The MCF...BX bearing is a metric, stud-type cam follower bearing. It is specifically designed for high-performance industrial applications such as conveyor systems and linear guidance, where it handles high radial loads and repeated shocks.  This design maximizes the number of needle rollers possible without a cage. This design provides significantly higher radial load capacity and superior resistance to shock loading compared to caged variants. Material :  Constructed from high-strength bearing steel with a Black Oxide Finish to provide a layer of corrosion resistance. Features are : Heavy-Section Outer Race, Open (Unsealed) Configuration, Temperature Range, Relubricatable Design, Dimensional Accuracy. Applications : Packaging and Labeling Machinery, Textile Machinery, Machine Tools, Food Processing, Heavy Construction & Earthmoving, CNC Machinery, Aerospace & Defence, Medical & Pharmaceutical. B=Cam Follower, Camrol, Hexagonal Hole Replaces Screwdriver Slot In Flange End Of Stem, X=Cylindrical Running Surface.

desc: MCF-S METRIC CAMROL FULL COMPLEMENT (SEALED) BEARING
tech: The MCF-S bearing represents a family of sealed stud-type cam followers within the CAMROL line. These bearings are designed to provide anti-friction support for linear movement or to follow the surface of a cam, offering a broad range of designs to suit various applications. The \"S\" designation indicates that these cam followers come with a LUBRI-DISC® seal, which helps retain lubrication and exclude contaminants, enhancing bearing life and performance. The outer race is slightly convex, allowing for better alignment and load distribution, which is particularly beneficial in applications with slight misalignment. High radial load capacity in a compact form factor. The MCF-S series features a stud-type mounting, facilitating easy installation and adjustment in various applications.

desc: MCF-SB METRIC CAMROL FULL COMPLEMENT (SEALED) BEARING
tech: The MCF...SB bearing is a metric stud-type cam follower bearing. It consists of a thick-walled outer ring, a full complement of needle rollers, and an integrated stud. Features full complement needle rollers (no cage), which maximizes the number of rolling elements to provide the highest possible dynamic and static load capacities. Material : High-strength chrome or carbon steel housing with an induction heat-treated inner stud, often finished with a black oxide coating for corrosion resistance. Features are : Shock Resistance, Misalignment Tolerance, Temperature Range, Easy installation and adjustment, P0 Equivalent Tolerance, Self-Venting Capabilities, Speed & Torque. Applications : Packaging Machinery, Conveyor Systems, Machine Tools, Automation Equipment, Material Handling, Printing and Textiles, Construction Machinery, Food and Beverage, Semiconductor Manufacturing, Medical & Pharmaceutical Labelling, Woodworking Machinery. S=Cam Follower, Camrol, Sealed Version, B=Cam Follower, Camrol, Hexagonal Hole Replaces Screwdriver Slot In Flange End Of Stem.

desc: MCF-SBX METRIC CAMROL FULL COMPLEMENT (SEALED) BEARING
tech: The MCF...SBX bearing is a high-capacity, metric stud-type cam follower designed for industrial motion applications. Unlike caged bearings, this model is \"full complement,\" meaning it is packed with the maximum number of needle rollers. This maximizes the radial load capacity and rigidity, though it limits the bearing to lower speeds compared to caged versions. Material : Constructed from high-strength bearing steel, hardened to 58–62 HRC to withstand repeated shocks, with a black oxide finish for enhanced corrosion resistance. Features are : Multiple Relubrication Paths, Shock Resistance, High Temperature Stability, Thick-Walled Outer Ring, Relubrication Points, Pre-Lubricated, Stricter Tolerances, Enhancing Service Life, Easy Installation. Applications : Automation & Robotics, Packaging & Bottling, Material Handling, Machine Tools, Textile & Printing, Aerospace & Defense, Medical & Pharmaceutical, Food & Beverage. S=Cam Follower, Camrol, Sealed Version, B=Cam Follower, Camrol, Hexagonal Hole Replaces Screwdriver Slot In Flange End Of Stem, X=Cylindrical Running Surface.

desc: MCF-SX METRIC CAMROL FULL COMPLEMENT (SEALED) BEARING
tech: The Nadella MCF.... SX bearing is a stud-type cam follower bearing (also known as a track roller) designed for high radial load applications in automation and industrial machinery. This specific model is a metric-sized component featuring a full complement of needle rollers and integral seals. Features a full complement of needle rollers (no cage), which allows for the maximum possible radial load capacity within its compact size. A heavy-section outer ring made of hardened rolling bearing steel (typically 58 to 62 HRC) to withstand repeated shocks and minimize deformation. It typically has a cylindrical outer profile. Material : High-quality bearing steel with a black oxide finish. Features are : High-Speed Performance, Wide Temperature Range, Impact and Shock Loading, Stricter Tolerances, Contamination Protection, Enhancing Service Life. Applications : Automation & Robotics, Material Handling & Conveyors, Packaging & Logistics Machinery, CNC & Machine Tools, Textile & Printing Machinery, Renewable Energy, Pharmaceutical & Food Processing. S=Cam Follower, Camrol, Sealed Version, X=Cylindrical Running Surface.

desc: MCF-X METRIC CAMROL FULL COMPLEMENT (UNSEALED) BEARING
tech: The MCF...X Bearing Straight Cylindrical Outside Roller Diameter Cam follower is a metric stud-type cam follower from the CAMROL series, designed for applications requiring high radial load capacity and precise linear motion. X = Cylindrical cam follower with flat rollers, unsealed. It Provides a large contact area, ideal for applications with flat cam profiles or where minimal misalignment is expected. Retained Needle Rollers: Maximizes radial load capacity in a compact design. Hex Hole Stud: Allows for secure mounting and easy installation. Open Design: Suitable for applications where external sealing is not critical. Jam Nuts and Lubrication Fitting: Included to facilitate maintenance and ensure proper lubrication. Common uses include: Automated machinery, Conveyor systems, Packaging equipment, Textile machinery etc.

desc: MCFD SERIES FULL COMPLIMENT CAM FOLLOWERS- HEAVY DUTY (SHIELDED)
tech: The CAMROL bearing series MCFD Metric bearings, which provide greater basic dynamic load ratings by utilizing cylindrical rollers in place of standard needle rollers. This construction allows the bearings to take heavier axial loading. MCFD = Heavy Duty Cam Follower Metric Size, Crowned OD, Screw Driver slot, Metal Seals on Both Side. A screw-driver slot is provided at the flanged end of the stud for the purpose of preventing the stud from turning when the nut is tightened. screw-driver slot is rounded and in some cases it may be necessary to use a special screw-driver having a rounded edge to hold the stud securely. Black oxide finish on all exposed surfaces for maximum corrosion resistance.

desc: MCFD-X SERIES FULL COMPLIMENT CAM FOLLOWERS- HEAVY DUTY (SHIELDED)
tech: The CAMROL bearing series MCFD Metric bearings, which provide greater basic dynamic load ratings by utilizing cylindrical rollers in place of standard needle rollers. desc: MCFR-S METRIC CAMROL CAGE TYPE (SEALED) BEARING

desc: MCYR SERIES METRIC CAM FOLLOWER - FULL COMPLEMENT (UNSEALED)

desc: MCYR-SX SERIES METRIC CAM FOLLOWER - FULL COMPLEMENT (SEALED)
tech: The MCYR...SX bearing is a track roller or support roller with needle rollers. These rolling elements combine high load capacity with a compact design. Track rollers are designed for use with various types of tracks. Thanks to a thick-walled outer ring, they can withstand high radial loads. Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. Yoke type track rollers are suitable for mounting on a shaft. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support. The MCYR10SX McGill has a full complement design. The absence of a cage allows for a greater number of rolling elements, making this track roller radially highly loadable. Full complement track rollers are also more shock-resistant than track rollers with a cage. However, the maximum rotational speed is lower than that of caged variants. Common applications of track rollers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam mechanisms. S=Cam Follower, Camrol, Sealed Version, X=Cylindrical Running Surface.

desc: MCYR-X METRIC CAMROL STRAIGHT CYLINDRICAL OUTSIDE ROLLER DIAMETER (UNSEALED)

The FAG WGTR bearing is a specialized high-performance back-up roller bearing designed for the extreme demands of multi-roll cold rolling mills. Unlike standard industrial bearings, the \"WGTR\" series is engineered to handle massive radial forces while maintaining the precise alignment of work rolls during metal thinning processes. These bearings utilize cylindrical rollers that provide line contact with the raceways, allowing them to support significantly heavier radial and impact loads than ball bearings of a similar size. Material : High-grade bearing steel (typically 100Cr6 or equivalent) optimized for high wear resistance. Features are : Unsealed for Emulsion Lubrication, Restricted Tolerances, Running Accuracy, High-Speed Stability, Simplified Maintenance, Reduced Friction, Heat Dissipation, Temperature Resistance. Applications : Metalworking & Metallurgy, Material-Handling Equipment and Conveyor Systems, Automotive & Transportation, Precision Lathes and Cutting Machines, Medical Equipment, Mining Crushers.

Material : The P147 material is a lead-free, maintenance-free composite featuring a steel backing, a sintered bronze interlayer, and an anti-wear PTFE sliding layer mixed with barium sulfate. Features are : Zero Stick-Slip Effect, Lead-Free Compliance, Excellent Corrosion Resistance, High Radial Rigidity, Broad Temperature Range, High Thermal Conductivity, Low Running Noise. Applications : Automotive Linkages, Medical Equipment, Aerospace Controls, Pneumatic & Hydraulic, Precision Electronics, Textile Machines, Packaging Lines, Printing Press Adjusters, Agricultural Machinery, Renewable Energy Systems, Construction Vehicles, Material Handling. P147=Designates the specialized, lead-free composite material layer matrix.

The PERMAGLIDE bushing is a maintenance-free, micro-sized cylindrical thin-wall plain bushing manufactured by Permaglide. Applications :  Automotive & Transportation Systems, Medical, Laboratory, & Fluid Technology, Pneumatic & Hydraulic Cylinders, Automation & Precision Robotics, Aerospace, Defense, and Marine Engineering, Renewable Energy and Power Generation. P180 = High-performance lead-free premium material matrix.

The material is a maintenance-free, anti-magnetic material consisting of a solid bronze backing layered with a sintered bronze matrix and a self-lubricating PTFE sliding surface. Features are : High Wear Resistance, High Load Resilience, Extreme Temperature Range, Ultra-Low Profile Footprint, Space-Saving Design, High Shock Absorbing and Damping Capacity, Boundary Lubrication Compatibility, Anti-Cavitation Threshold, Explosive Media Compatibility. Applications : Industrial Pumps, Pneumatic Cylinders, Hydraulic & Fluid Power Systems, Marine Equipment, Medical Devices, Power Generation, Agricultural & Construction Machinery, Packaging, Printing & Logistics. P11=Maintenance Free, With Bronze Backing.

Features are : Stick-Slip Prevention, High Shock Absorption, Edge-Load Insensitivity, Space-Saving Design, Shaft Protection, High Wear Resistance, Lubrication Retention, Wide Temperature Range. Applications : Automotive & Transportation Systems, Pneumatic & Hydraulic Cylinders, Agricultural Equipment, Construction Equipment, Industrial Gearboxes, Textile & Packaging Machinery, Energy, Power Generation & Renewables, Material Handling, Food Processing Equipment, Packaging Machinery. P200=Specifies The Exact Low-Maintenance Material Matrix Blend Used For The Sliding Layer.

The Permaglide Bushing is a high-performance, low-maintenance metal-polymer composite plain bearing strip manufactured by Permaglide. Designed for heavy-duty industrial and automotive systems, the P23 series is engineered to operate under continuous or hydrodynamic fluid lubrication. The strip features a cross-sectional multi-layer system optimized for load-bearing strength and continuous low-friction sliding. It utilizes a rigid steel backing bonded to a porous bronze sinter matrix, which is subsequently impregnated with a polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) polymer blend containing lead. Featuresare : Low Friction Coefficient, Emergency Running Properties, High Load Capacity, High Wear Resistance, Corrosion Protection, Simplified Assembly, Reduced Stick-Slip, Excellent Thermal Dissipation, Zero Moisture Absorption. Applications : Automotive & Transport Engineering, Marine & Offshore Engineering, Energy & Power Generation, Printing, Packaging, & Paper Processing, Textile Machinery, Industrial Pumps & Fluid Power, Construction Machinery, Pneumatic Press Slides. P23=Without Oil Dtributing Pocket, Ready To Install.

The BCCYR is a heavy-duty crowned cam yoke roller bearing. It is engineered as a yoke-mounted track roller designed to handle high radial loads and cushion shock impacts in automated machinery. Bushing-type or variant profile of the classic CCYR series (Crowned Cam Yoke Roller). This profile alters the contact area to prevent damaging stress concentrations at the edges if minor angular misalignment exists between the roller and the track. It is instead designed to be mounted directly onto a pin, bolt, or shaft supported at both ends, providing substantially higher rigidity than a single cantilevered stud. This maximizes the internal contact surface area to support massive radial load thresholds. Material: High-carbon chrome steel, black-oxide treated bearing steel. Features are : Thick-Walled Outer Ring, Low-Friction Operation, Broad Temperature Range, Integrated Re-Lubrication System. Applications : Conveyor Systems, Packaging Machinery, Printing & Paper Processing, Textile Equipment, Construction Equipment, Marine & Port Machinery, Agriculture Machinery. S=Sealed (Lubri-Disc®).

This bearing features a full complement of needle rollers packed directly between the outer race and the inner race. This design eliminates the need for a retaining cage, maximizing the number of rollers to achieve exceptionally high static radial load-carrying capabilities. The outer ring is extra-thick to withstand continuous heavy shock loading and minimize deformation under stress. Material: High-carbon chrome steel, black-oxide treated bearing steel. Features are : Low-Inertia Movement, Low Startup Torque, Vibration Dampening Core, Extended Service Intervals, Internal Lubrication Hole, Axial Stabilization. The CCFD is a high-capacity, heavy-duty stud-type cam follower bearing. It is engineered specifically for demanding industrial automation and material handling structures where traditional needle roller bearings cannot survive the extreme mechanical stresses. Unlike standard needle cam followers that use a separator cage, the CFD series utilizes a complete row of large cylindrical rollers packed tightly together. This design maximizes the internal steel-on-steel contact area to transfer extreme radial and sudden shock loads. This slight curvature prevents \"edge loading\" stresses if the structural track tracks out of perfect parallel alignment, distributing weight evenly across the centre of the roller path. Features are : Black Oxide Protection,  Maintenance-Free Lifespan, Temperature Limits, High Structural Reliability Under Stress, Simplified Installation & Replacement. Applications : Packaging & Bottling Machinery, Primary Metal, Mining, & Steel Processing, Wood Processing & Sawmills, Construction & Mining Machinery.

Features are : Black Oxide Protection,  Maintenance-Free Lifespan, Temperature Limits, High Structural Reliability Under Stress, Simplified Installation & Replacement. Applications : Packaging & Bottling Machinery, Primary Metal, Mining, & Steel Processing, Wood Processing & Sawmills, Construction & Mining Machinery.

The CCFD is a high-capacity, heavy-duty stud-type cam follower bearing. It is engineered specifically for demanding industrial automation and material handling structures where traditional needle roller bearings cannot survive the extreme mechanical stresses. Unlike standard needle cam followers that use a separator cage, the CFD series utilizes a complete row of large cylindrical rollers packed tightly together. This design maximizes the internal steel-on-steel contact area to transfer extreme radial and sudden shock loads. This slight curvature prevents \"edge loading\" stresses if the structural track tracks out of perfect parallel alignment, distributing weight evenly across the centre of the roller path. Features are : Black Oxide Protection,  Maintenance-Free Lifespan, Temperature Limits, High Structural Reliability Under Stress, Simplified Installation & Replacement. Applications : Packaging & Bottling Machinery, Primary Metal, Mining, & Steel Processing, Wood Processing & Sawmills, Construction & Mining Machinery.

The CCFE refers to a highly specific crowned, stud-type cam follower bearing with a screwdriver slot. The \"CCFE\" designation indicates that it features a crowned outer ring (to prevent edge loading) and an eccentric stud. This built-in offset allows you to rotate the stud to fine-tune the radial position of the roller. Material : The bearing is made from high-strength 52100 chrome steel and case-hardened alloy steel with a rust-resistant black oxide finish and synthetic rubber seals. Features are : Multi-Point Relubrication Paths, Thick-Walled Outer Ring, High Clamping Security, Low-Friction Flange Faces, Radial Kinematics & Adjustability, Optimized Roller End Clearance. Material : It is through-hardened 52100 high-carbon chrome bearing steel finished with a corrosion-resistant black oxide coating. Features are : Optimized Roller End Geometry, Low Turning Torque Friction, Heat Treatment, Multi-Point Relubrication, Screwdriver Slot Drive, Anti-Blowout Safety Vents. The CCYR bearing is a heavy-duty, yoke-type cam follower track roller bearing. It features a crowned outer ring profile and internal full-complement needle rollers to handle high radial loads and accommodate minor angular misalignment. A crowned outer diameter paired with integral rubber seals on both sides to retain grease and keep out contaminants. Stands for Yoke Roller style, indicating a track roller designed for straddle mounting between supports using a pin or shaft (as opposed to a stud type). Material: Typically constructed from high-grade chrome steel or 52100 bearing steel featuring a corrosion-resistant black oxide finish. Features are : Extends Component Life, Higher Structural Rigidity, High Static Resistance, Integrated Relubrication Pathway, Zoned Heat Treatment, Vibration Dampening. Applications : Conveyor Systems & Materials Handling, Automation & Linear Motion Guideways, Steel Mill Equipment, Lifting & Construction Equipment, Food Processing & Washdown Areas, Aerospace and Defense Support Equipment, Energy and Power Generation. S=Sealed (Lubri-Disc®).

The CF is a cam follower with needle rollers. These rolling elements combine high load capacity with a compact design. Cam followers are designed for use with various types of tracks. Thanks to a thick-walled outer ring, they can withstand high radial loads. Instead of an inner ring, they feature a solid, threaded stud, enabling easy mounting. Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support.These bearing has a full complement design. The absence of a cage allows for a greater number of rolling elements, making this cam follower radially highly loadable. Common applications of cam followers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam mechanisms. S=Sealed (Lubri-Disc®).

The CFD is a high-capacity, heavy-duty stud-type cam follower bearing engineered for automation and high-shock industrial track roller applications.Features a double-row, full-complement arrangement of cylindrical rolling elements rather than standard needle rollers. This maximizes the internal contact area to withstand intense radial forces and shock conditions.Manufactured with a flat/cylindrical outside diameter. This ensures uniform distribution of load when rolling against flat, hardened tracks. Material : Constructed high-grade 52100 bearing steel treated with a black oxide finish for enhanced corrosion and wear protection. Features are : Sealed Protection & Lubrication, Reduced Internal Friction, Higher Speed Ratings, High-Rigidity Shell. Applications : Materials Handling & Automation Systems, Packaging & Production Machinery, Metalworking & Automotive Manufacturing, Foundry, Steel, & Heavy Industrial Plants, Aerospace & Defense Equipment, Construction & Mining Machinery.

The CFE bearing is a specialized, industrial-grade eccentric stud-type cam follower bearing. Unlike standard concentric cam followers, the \"E\" in CFE indicates an eccentric bushing over the stud. This lets technicians eliminate backlash, adjust alignment, or evenly balance loads across multiple bearings. It uses a cage-less, full complement design filled with precision needle rollers. This maximizes the available steel surface area inside the roller to support high-impact radial forces. Material : The bearing is constructed from high-purity, vacuum-degassed chrome steel (GCr15/52100) with a black oxide finish for maximum wear resistance and rust protection. Features are : Thick-Walled Outer Ring, Integrated Lubrication Ports, Optimized Roller End Profiles, Super-Finished Raceways, Low Operating Temperatures. Applications : Material Handling & Conveyor Systems, Automation, Robotics & Linear Guides, Packaging & Bottling Machinery, Heavy Machinery & Production Equipment, Aerospace & Defense Systems.

Material : It is made of high-carbon 52100 chrome bearing steel treated with a corrosion-resistant black oxide finish. Features are : Advanced Relubrication Pathway, Radial Play Optimization, Reduced Internal Friction, Cooler Operating Temperatures, Maximum Limiting Speed. Applications : Conveyor Systems, Packaging Machinery, Metalworking Equipment, Printing & Paper Processing, Textile Machinery, Construction & Mining, Food Processing & Pharmaceutical, Woodworking & Sawmill Systems.

The CRSB bearing is an metric-series, sealed, stud-type needle cam follower designed to handle high radial and shock loads in cam and track applications. The robust outer ring is designed to run directly on a track and helps minimize deformation and bending stresses when subjected to heavy radial and shock loads. These bearing a non-separable, ready-to-mount unit that integrates an outer ring, full complement of needle rollers, lip seals, internal thrust washers, and a robust stud. Material: It is typically made from high carbon chrome steel, with a black oxide finish applied to the surface for corrosion resistance. Features are : Lubrication Management System, Precision and Tolerances, Compactness, High Load Capacity, Corrosion Protection, Operating Conditions, High Rigidity and Accuracy, Low Friction. Applications : Material Handling and Indexing Equipment, Automation and Robotics, Machinery and Manufacturing, Automotive and Transportation, Packaging and Processing, Aerospace and Defense, Power Generation and Mining, Food and Beverage Processing.

The CYR bearing is a specialized, heavy-duty mechanical component classified as a yoke-type track roller or cam follower. Unlike standard ball bearings designed for high-speed shaft rotation, this bearing is engineered to roll directly along flat tracks, cams, ramps, and conveyor beds under extreme loads. This bearing does not have an integrated threaded stud. Instead, it features a precision-ground inner ring (bore) meant to be mounted onto a support pin, shaft, or clevis. The inner cavity is packed completely with cylindrical needle rollers without using a retaining cage. This maximizes the internal contact surface area, allowing the bearing to absorb massive radial forces and sudden impact shocks. Features are : Thick-Walled Outer Ring, Shock Absorption, Low Profile, Reduced Friction, Internal Axial Thrust Washers, Built-In Lubrication Refill Zones, Heat Expansion Tolerance. Applications : Packaging & Bottling Machinery, Metalworking & Heavy Industrial Equipment, Construction, Mining & Marine, Aerospace, Defense & Aviation.

Unlike standard ball bearings designed for high-speed shaft rotation, this bearing is engineered to roll directly along flat tracks, cams, ramps, and conveyor beds under extreme loads. This bearing does not have an integrated threaded stud. Instead, it features a precision-ground inner ring (bore) meant to be mounted onto a support pin, shaft, or clevis. The inner cavity is packed completely with cylindrical needle rollers without using a retaining cage. This maximizes the internal contact surface area, allowing the bearing to absorb massive radial forces and sudden impact shocks. Features are : Thick-Walled Outer Ring, Shock Absorption, Low Profile, Reduced Friction, Internal Axial Thrust Washers, Built-In Lubrication Refill Zones, Heat Expansion Tolerance. Applications : Packaging & Bottling Machinery, Metalworking & Heavy Industrial Equipment, Construction, Mining & Marine, Aerospace, Defense & Aviation. S=Sealed (Lubri-Disc®), CR=Stainless Steel or Specialized Rust-Proof Coating.

The FCF is a ball-bearing stud type track roller or cam follower, of which the rolling elements combine low friction with high precision. Cam followers are designed for use with various types of tracks. Thanks to a thick-walled outer ring, they can withstand high radial loads. Instead of an inner ring, they feature a solid, threaded stud, enabling easy mounting. Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support. These bearing is equipped with a cage that prevents the rolling elements from coming into contact with each other. This design allows for a controlled movement of the rolling elements. There is lower friction compared to full complement cam followers, allowing for higher rotational speeds and less heat generation. Common applications of support rollers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam mechanisms.

Instead of an inner ring, they feature a solid, threaded stud, enabling easy mounting. Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support. These bearing is equipped with a cage that prevents the rolling elements from coming into contact with each other. This design allows for a controlled movement of the rolling elements. There is lower friction compared to full complement cam followers, allowing for higher rotational speeds and less heat generation. Common applications of support rollers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam mechanisms.

The FCFE is a heavy-duty, stud-type flanged track roller bearing. It features an eccentric stud configuration, a flanged outside diameter, and precision ball bearing inserts designed to handle both radial and thrust loads. Unlike standard cam followers that utilize needle rollers for purely radial loads, the series uses a double-row precision ball bearing insert. This specific geometry allows the bearing to comfortably absorb thrust loads generated when the side flange comes into contact with a guide rail or structural track. Material : Constructed from through-hardened 52100 carbon chrome steel finished with a corrosion-resistant black oxide coating. Features are : Thick Outer Ring, Compact Footprint, High Shock Absorption, Low Starting Friction, Smooth Profile Transitions. Applications : Material Handling & Conveyor Systems, Packaging & Production Machinery, Automation & Robotics, Textile & Paper Processing, Renewable Energy & Aerospace Systems, Construction Equipment, Marine & Offshore Machining, Food, Pharma & Lab Production.

The FCYR is a high-capacity, heavy-duty flanged yoke roller bearing. This precision-engineered component features an integrated tapered roller bearing internal design, allowing it to support substantial combined radial and axial thrust loads simultaneously. It functions as a yoke-mounted (straddle-mounted) guide wheel for linear guidance systems, tracks, and automation tracks. Material : It is constructed from through-hardened 52100 high-carbon chrome steel treated with a corrosion-resistant black oxide finish. Features are : Thick Outer Ring, Maintenance-Free Design, Axial Thrust Performance, Extreme Temperature Threshold, Shock-Absorbing Core, Vibration Damping Properties, Low Rolling Resistance. Applications : Packaging & Bottling Machinery, Mining, Processing, & Marine Equipment, Medical Diagnostic Imaging Gantry Systems, Aerospace & Defense Equipment, Material Handling & Warehouse Automation.

The MI is an precision-ground needle roller bearing inner ring (inner race) engineered for heavy-duty industrial power transmission. It functions as a separable component for machined race needle roller bearings, allowing the inner ring to be mounted directly onto a shaft where the shaft itself cannot be hardened or ground to function as a raceway. Material : Manufactured from premium AISI 52100 high-carbon chrome steel. This provides optimal core toughness and resistance to fatigue under deep cyclic loads. Features are : Integrated Lubrication Architecture, Shaft Protection, Axial Displacement Allowance, High Concentricity, Low Start-Up Torque, Vibration Damping Profile, Misalignment Tolerance. Applications : Steel Rolling Mills, Paper Mill Machinery, Pulp Processing Equipment, Construction Machinery, Textile Manufacturing, Printing Presses, Renewable Energy, Marine & Aerospace Ground Support, Material Handling & Agriculture Machinery.

The NUCF-RQ is a precision-engineered, metric series heavy-duty stud-type cam follower bearing. Unlike standard needle roller cam followers, the NUCF series incorporates a double-row full-complement cylindrical roller system inside an extra-thick outer ring. This design configuration allows the assembly to withstand extreme radial pressures, shock loads, and bi-directional axial thrust loads simultaneously. Material : Through-hardened carbon-chromium steel (SUJ2/100Cr6) to provide exceptional fatigue life and resistance. Features  are : Multi-Point Lubrication, High Static Load Rating, Tight Geometric Tolerances, Structural Rigidity, Vibration and Noise Reduction, Atmospheric Protection. Applications : Conveyor Systems, Machine Tooling, Medical Packaging & Logistics, Printing and Paper Processing, Food & Beverage Processing, Construction & Woodworking Machining, Steel & Metal Processing, Textile Manufacturing, Aerospace & Aviation. R=Crowned (Spherical) Outer Ring, Q= Optimized Internal Labyrinth Seals.

The NUKR is a cam follower with cylindrical rollers. These rolling elements combine a high load capacity with reasonable shock resistance. Cam followers are designed for use with various types of tracks. Thanks to a thick-walled outer ring, they can withstand high radial loads. Instead of an inner ring, they feature a solid, threaded stud, enabling easy mounting. Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support. These cam follower has a full complement design. The absence of a cage allows for a greater number of rolling elements, making this cam follower radially highly loadable. Full complement cam followers are also more shock-resistant than cam followers with a cage. However, the maximum rotational speed is lower than that of caged variants. Common applications of cam followers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam followers. H=Hexagonal Socket.

desc: TRACK ROLLER AND CAM FOLLOWER BEARING
tech: The PCF is a ball-bearing stud type track roller or cam follower, of which the rolling elements combine low friction with high precision. Cam followers are designed for use with various types of tracks. Thanks to a thick-walled outer ring, they can withstand high radial loads. Instead of an inner ring, they feature a solid, threaded stud, enabling easy mounting. Axial loads due to alignment errors or misalignment can be absorbed in both directions. They are not mounted in a housing bore, but a flat (counter) track provides support.The bearing is a equipped with a cage that prevents the rolling elements from coming into contact with each other. This design allows for a controlled movement of the rolling elements. There is lower friction compared to full complement cam followers, allowing for higher rotational speeds and less heat generation. Common applications of support rollers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam mechanisms.

Common applications of support rollers include conveyor systems, linear guidance systems, and cam mechanisms.

These bearing is a high-rigidity, standard series 14 crossed roller slewing ring bearing designed by INA to provide high rotational accuracy and multi-directional load management in a compact space. This precision component is characterized by its internal ring integration, pre-drilled fixing holes, and lack of external or internal gear teeth. Cylindrical rollers alternate at 90° angles across a V-groove raceway, enabling a single row to handle radial, axial, and overturning moment load pressures simultaneously. Material : Manufactured from high-purity, through-hardened 100Cr6 chrome bearing steel with NBR rubber seals and plastic internal spacers. Features are : Omnidirectional Load Handling, Internal Plastic Spacers, Low Starting Torque, High Tilting Rigidity, Broad Temperature Range, Superfinished Raceways, Predictable Fatigue LifePre-Lubricated Component. Applications : Robotic & Automation Systems, Machine Tool & Woodworking Machinery, Medical & Laboratory Technology, Renewable Energy & Aerospace, Packaging & Printing Machinery, Marine & Defense Systems.

These bearing is a precision, light-series four-point contact ball slewing ring bearing designed by INA. Engineered to simultaneously transmit heavy radial, axial, and tilting moment loads in compact spaces, this specific model is integrated with an internal gear drive mechanism and heavy-duty double-sided contact lip seals. The inner ring features precision-cut gear teeth. This layout allows the bearing to act as a structural load carrier and a mechanical drive component, saving space by removing the need for an external drive ring. Material : Made of induction-hardened forged steel paired with high-grade carbon chromium steel balls, a polyamide spacer cage, and nitrile butadiene rubber (NBR) lip seals. Features are : Built-in Relubrication Ports, Low Rotational Resistance Balance, Friction Locking Performance, Segmented Spacers, Induction-Hardened Raceways. Applications : Construction & Material Handling Equipment, Packaging and Bottling Machinery, Renewable Energy & Utilities, Agricultural & Specialized Vehicles, Maritime & Offshore Engineering. N=Normalized Gear Teeth On Bearing Ring.

These bearing is a specialty, high-capacity stud-type cam follower (track roller) bearing designed by INA. It is engineered primarily for precision heavy-duty industrial applications, serving extensively as an OEM printing press replacement component. Designates a stud-type cam follower that uses a full complement of cylindrical rollers (no cage) instead of standard needle rollers. This design provides the highest possible radial load capacity. The outer ring is significantly thicker than standard bearings to withstand high bending stresses. Material : The bearing is made of high-grade, heavy-duty chrome steel designed to withstand extreme impact and heavy radial loads. Features are : Vibration & Noise Grades, Shock Absorption, Dual-Side Axial Guidance Elements, Comprehensive Relubrication Channels, Reduced Internal Friction, Lower Heat Generation. Applications : Materials Handling & Conveyor Systems, Packaging & Bottling Automation, Construction Equipment, Powertrain & Transmission Assemblies, Material Handling & Lifting. NUKRE=Stud-Type Cam Follower With a Full Complement of Cylindrical Rollers And An Eccentric Collar.

These bearing is a high-capacity track roller bearing manufactured by INA. It is engineered primarily for high-load, heavy-duty applications like cam drives, conveyor systems, guidance tracks, and agricultural machinery. Unlike standard deep groove ball bearings that fit into tightly enclosed housings, this track roller runs directly on flat or mating counter-tracks. The outer steel ring is heavily reinforced and thick-walled to safely absorb crushing radial pressures and localized distortion. Material : Made of high-purity, through-hardened 100Cr6 carbon-chromium bearing steel, equipped with synthetic rubber seals and a glass-fiber reinforced polyamide 66 cage. Features are : High Radial Load Resistance, Enhanced Inner Ring Undercut, Surface Finish Excellence, Maintenance-Free, For-Life Lubrication, Broad Temperature Envelope. Applications : Printing & Textile Machinery, Packaging Automation Plant Gear, Marine & Offshore Systems, Automotive Production & Assembly, Forestry, Mining & Construction Equipment, Energy & Infrastructure, Medical Equipment. These bearing is a premium quality deflection/guide pulley (commonly referred to as an idler pulley). It ensures the accessory belt wraps tightly around high-load engine components like the alternator, power steering pump, and air conditioning compressor. By stabilizing the belt track, it eliminates belt flutter, limits vibrations, reduces noise levels, and prevents premature belt wear. Material  : Constructed from heavy-duty, high-grade steel paired with high-performance synthetic rubber dual-lip contact seals. These bearing is a highly specialized, heavy-duty industrial stud-type cam follower (track roller) bearing engineered by INA. Features an integrated concentric solid metal pin (shaft) that acts as the internal core of the unit. This threaded rod design lets you bolt the roller directly into machine arms, link bars, or guide plates using a single hexagonal nut without needing a separate axle pin. These bearing is a high-rigidity, toothless crossed roller slewing ring bearing. These bearing is a heavy-duty stud-type track roller (cam follower) designed and manufactured by INA. The YRTC...XL is a double-direction axial/radial cylindrical roller bearing engineered by Schaeffler. Part of the high-performance X-life family, this super-precision bearing is optimized for multi-axis CNC machines, milling heads, and rotary tables. By restructuring the adjacent design, it achieves up to 20% more tilting rigidity and up to 80% higher limiting speeds compared to previous YRT generations. Combines two axial roller assemblies and radial roller assembly to simultaneously support bidirectional axial thrust, radial force, and massive tilting moments. Material : Manufactured from ultra-clean, high-purity carbon-chromium rolling bearing steel (typically 100Cr6 / SAE 52100) with a high-performance composite plastic cage. Features are : Integrated Lubrication, Low Frictional Torque, Optimized Roller Profiling, Enhanced Heat Dissipation, Superfinished Raceways, Corrosion-Protection Compatibility. Applications : Precision Robotics & Automation, Measurement & Inspection Systems, Semiconductor & Electronics Manufacturing, Aerospace, Defense & Optical Tracking, Energy & Medical Technology. LR= Track Roller Series Designator.

These bearing is a heavy-duty yoke-type track roller bearing manufactured by INA. The bearing features a dual-row, full-complement cylindrical roller assembly. It does not utilize a cage, allowing the maximum possible number of rollers to be packed into the space to optimize load handling. It is constructed with an extra-thick outer ring. This design helps it withstand massive radial forces, prevent deformation under stress, and distribute localized pressures smoothly over flat tracks or guide surfaces. Unlike standard bearings that press into a housing bore, this yoke-type roller mounts directly onto a static shaft or stud pin, running explicitly against an open (counter) track. Material : Manufactured from through-hardened, high-purity carbon-chromium bearing steel (typically 100Cr6) combined with steel-reinforced NBR rubber contact seals. Features are : Multi-Directional Load Management, Lubrication Maintenance, Broad Temperature Operational. Applications : Material Handling & Logistics, Printing & Paper Machinery, Construction & Infrastructure, Marine, Port Infrastructure & Heavy Transit, Mining & Bulk Material Conveyors. PWTR=Bearing Type.

These bearing is a specialized radial spherical plain bearing designed for heavy industrial machinery. It is engineered by INA and is highly regarded for its precision and reliability in managing high loads and component misalignments. The bearing consists of a convex inner ring and a concave outer ring matched flawlessly without any traditional rolling elements. This large contact area distributes forces over a much greater surface, giving it a drastically higher load capacity compared to standard ball bearings. Material : Manufactured entirely from high-grade, hardened rolling-bearing steel with a manganese-phosphated coating on the sliding contact surfaces. Features are : Misalignment & Oscillation Accommodation, Integrated Lubrication Grooves, Thermal Range Capability, Shock Load Resistance, Low Initial Friction Torque. Applications : Construction Machinery & Earthmoving Equipment, Agricultural & Forestry Vehicles, Mining & Drilling Equipment, Material Handling & Cranes, Paper & Pulp Processing Machinery. GE=Not A Suffix, But Used To Identify The Bearing.

These bearing is a heavy-duty commercial vehicle deflection/guide pulley (also known as an idler pulley) for V-ribbed serpentine accessory belts. Manufactured by INA brand, it is designed to manage high load changes and maintain optimal belt tracking in large transport engines. Unlike standard passenger car pulleys made of plastic or composite materials, this unit is machined entirely from high-strength metal. This prevents warping, cracking, and surface distortion under intense heat and heavy belt load. Material : Constructed entirely from high-grade, heavy-duty metal (forged steel alloy) with an electrochemical anti-corrosion coating. Features are : Precision Smooth Running Surface, High-Load Ball Bearings, Vibration and Harmonic Dampening, Super-Finished Bearing Raceways, High-Shear Synthetic Lubricant, Operational & Environmental Reliability. Applications : Extended Vocational Truck, Large Agricultural Harvesters, Long-Haul Freight & Logistics, Heavy Construction & Vocational Work.
